abstract: We developed a gait foundation model from three-dimensional skeletal motion data of 3,328 deeply phenotyped adults, recorded using a depth camera during five motor tasks. Embeddings significantly predicted 1,887 of 3,210 phenotypic targets and provided predictive gains across all 18 body systems in men and 17 out of 18 in women, while also improving prediction of clinical diagnoses and medication use.
zh_abstract: 我们基于3,328名经过深度表型分析的成年人的三维骨骼运动数据，开发了一个步态基础模型（gait foundation model），这些数据由深度摄像头在五项运动任务中记录。所得嵌入（embeddings）显著预测了3,210个表型目标中的1,887个，在男性的全部18个身体系统以及女性的18个系统中的17个均带来预测增益，同时还改善了对临床诊断和用药情况的预测。

title: Multimodal cell foundation models require synergistic integration beyond alignment
zh_title: 多模态细胞基础模型需要超越对齐的协同整合
summary: 提出基于部分信息分解的协同信息得分，用于衡量冻结单模态专家融合后跨模态交互带来的额外信息增益。
key_points: 针对稀缺配对数据下的组合式基础模型
提出Synergistic Information Score指标
指出对齐类目标可能无法捕捉协同信息
reason: 同行评审的细胞基础模型方法与理论，新意较好，摘要未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Integrating measurements across modalities and scales into unified quantitative frameworks of cellular function is a central goal in computational biology. Although powerful unimodal foundation models exist, the scarcity of large-scale paired data limits joint multimodal training. This constraint favours compositional foundation models, which fuse frozen unimodal experts through a learned interface. However, it remains unclear when such fusion provides task-relevant information beyond the strongest unimodal representation rather than merely aggregating redundant signal. Here we introduce Synergistic Information Score, a metric grounded in partial information decomposition that quantifies information gain arising only from cross-modal interactions. Extending theory from self-supervised learning, we show that standard alignment-based objectives with frozen encoders collapse to detect linear redundancies, which constrains their ability to capture nonlinear synergistic states. This distinction is especially important for tasks that connect tissue morphology with gene expression. Benchmarking ten fusion methods on spatial transcriptomics datasets, we demonstrate that tasks dominated by linear redundancies are well served by unimodal baselines, whereas complex niche definitions benefit from synergy-aware integration. Finally, we perform a scaling analysis and show that fine-tuning a dominant unimodal expert is the most sample-efficient strategy for standard tasks. Together, these results suggest that progress in multimodal modelling of cellular state requires shifting from alignment-based objectives to synergy-driven integration that exploits complementary cross-modal signal.
zh_abstract: 将跨模态、跨尺度的测量整合为统一的细胞功能定量框架，是计算生物学的核心目标。尽管已有强大的单模态基础模型，但大规模配对数据的稀缺限制了联合多模态训练。这一限制使得组合式基础模型更具优势，即通过学习得到的接口融合冻结的单模态专家模型。然而，目前尚不清楚这种融合何时能够提供超出最强单模态表征的、与任务相关的信息，而不仅仅是汇聚冗余信号。在此，我们提出协同信息得分（Synergistic Information Score），这是一种基于部分信息分解的指标，用于量化仅由跨模态相互作用产生的信息增益。通过扩展自监督学习的理论，我们表明，采用冻结编码器的标准基于对齐的目标会退化为仅检测线性冗余，这限制了其捕捉非线性协同状态的能力。这一区别对于连接组织形态与基因表达的任务尤为重要。我们在空间转录组学数据集上对十种融合方法进行了基准测试，结果表明，以线性冗余为主的任务使用单模态基线即可很好地完成，而复杂的微环境（niche）定义则受益于考虑协同作用的整合。最后，我们进行了规模扩展分析，结果显示，对于标准任务，微调占主导地位的单模态专家模型是样本效率最高的策略。综上，这些结果提示，细胞状态的多模态建模要取得进展，需要从基于对齐的目标转向利用互补跨模态信号的协同驱动整合。

title: Health-System-Wide Mapping of Demographic Information in Routine Clinical Histopathology
zh_title: 常规临床组织病理中人口学信息的全health system映射
summary: 分析25个器官、257,322名患者的130万张H&E全切片，利用病理基础模型表征评估性别、年龄、种族信息的可恢复性。
key_points: 130万张WSI，25个器官
性别、年龄、种族平均AUROC为0.828、0.733、0.662
类别平衡后性能变化较小
reason: 超大规模病理数据，涉及公平性与基础模型；预印本未提外部验证，限于上限内偏高
abstract: The extent to which demographic-associated information is detectable across organs and disease states in routine clinical histopathology remains unclear. Here, we analyzed 1.3 million hematoxylin and eosin whole-slide images from 257,322 patients across 25 organs, using pathology foundation-model representations and multiple-instance learning to systematically map information associated with sex, age group, and self-reported race. Across 69 organ-demographic combinations, demographic attributes were broadly recoverable, with pan-organ mean AUROCs of 0.828 for sex, 0.733 for age group, and 0.662 for self-reported race, and substantial variation across organs. Demographic-class balancing produced relatively small changes in performance, while evaluation within diagnosis-text clusters showed modest attenuation. Under training with diagnosis-based grouping, demographic-associated signals remained detectable across multiple organs, including sex in gastric tissue (AUROC 0.865), age group in breast (0.816), and self-reported race in skin (0.728). Literature-guided analysis of these settings generated candidate histomorphological and contextual explanations for further investigation. Together, these findings provide a systematic map of demographic-associated information in routine histopathology, informing investigations of its sources, assessments of potential shortcut learning, and the development of more interpretable computational pathology models.
zh_abstract: 在常规临床组织病理学中，与人口统计学相关的信息在多大程度上可跨器官和疾病状态被检测到，目前仍不清楚。本研究分析了来自25个器官、257,322名患者的130万张苏木精-伊红全切片图像，利用病理基础模型表征和多实例学习，系统描绘与性别、年龄组和自报种族相关的信息。在69种器官-人口统计学组合中，人口统计学属性总体上均可被识别：性别、年龄组和自报种族的泛器官平均AUROC分别为0.828、0.733和0.662，且不同器官间差异显著。按人口统计学类别进行均衡处理后，性能变化相对较小；在诊断文本聚类内进行评估时，性能略有减弱。在基于诊断分组的训练下，与人口统计学相关的信号在多个器官中仍可检测到，包括胃组织中的性别（AUROC 0.865）、乳腺中的年龄组（0.816）以及皮肤中的自报种族（0.728）。针对这些情形，结合文献的分析提出了可供进一步研究的候选组织形态学和背景性解释。总之，这些发现提供了常规组织病理学中人口统计学相关信息的系统图谱，可为探究其来源、评估潜在的捷径学习以及开发更具可解释性的计算病理学模型提供参考。

title: Artificial intelligence in glaucoma diagnosis and management: a systematic review of the past decade (2015-2026).
source: PubMed · Expert review of medical devices
zh_title: 青光眼AI诊断与管理系统综述（2015–2026）
summary: 按PRISMA完成系统综述，纳入63项研究，评估青光眼AI技术、影像模态、验证策略及临床转化障碍。
key_points: 检索3758条记录，纳入63项研究
多为眼底照、OCT等深度学习
PROSPERO注册，讨论临床转化障碍
reason: 规范系统综述但纳入量中等，综述档
abstract: [Expert review of medical devices] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being used to support glaucoma detection and monitoring, with rapid advances in deep learning, multimodal imaging, and longitudinal prediction. This review evaluates the evidence supporting these developments and identifies barriers to clinical translation. A systematic search of PubMed, IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, and SpringerLink was conducted following PRISMA guidelines, with the protocol registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261450819). Of 3,758 records identified, 63 eligible peer-reviewed studies published between 2015 and 2026 were included. The review examined AI techniques, imaging modalities, datasets, diagnostic and predictive performance, validation strategies, and reported limitations in Glaucoma care. Most studies used deep learning applied to fundus photography, optical coherence tomography (OCT), OCT angiography, visual fields, or multimodal data. Many models achieved an area under the ROC curve of approximately 0.95. AI has substantial potential to improve glaucoma detection and monitoring, but high reported accuracy alone does not establish clinical readiness. Prospective multicenter validation using diverse populations, explainable and reproducible models, standardized evaluation, and integration into clinical workflows are essential before widespread implementation.
zh_abstract: [医疗器械专家评论] 随着深度学习、多模态成像和纵向预测的快速发展，人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于辅助青光眼的检测和监测。本综述评估了支持这些进展的证据，并指出了临床转化的障碍。我们按照PRISMA指南系统检索了PubMed、IEEE Xplore、ScienceDirect和SpringerLink，研究方案已在PROSPERO注册（CRD420261450819）。在检索到的3,758条记录中，纳入了2015年至2026年间发表的63项符合条件的同行评审研究。本综述考察了青光眼诊疗中的AI技术、成像方式、数据集、诊断和预测性能、验证策略以及报告的局限性。大多数研究将深度学习应用于眼底照相、光学相干断层扫描（OCT）、OCT血管成像、视野或多模态数据。许多模型的ROC曲线下面积约为0.95。AI在改善青光眼检测和监测方面具有巨大潜力，但仅凭报告的高准确性并不能说明其已具备临床应用条件。在广泛应用之前，必须进行涵盖多样化人群的前瞻性多中心验证、采用可解释且可重复的模型、实施标准化评估，并融入临床工作流程。

title: Artificial intelligence analysis of oral mucosal lesions in white-light clinical photographs: A systematic review of visual features and validation.
source: PubMed · European journal of oral sciences
zh_title: 口腔黏膜病变白光照片AI分析的系统综述
summary: 系统综述纳入53项研究，评估AI对口腔白光照片的视觉特征表征、验证与临床转化情况。
key_points: 纳入53项研究，30项发表于2025-2026年
用PROBAST+AI评估偏倚
检索PubMed、Embase、Scopus等库
reason: 系统综述纳入53项研究，有信息量，受综述上限约束
abstract: [European journal of oral sciences] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to conventional oral photographs for recognition, classification, localization, segmentation, and risk assessment of oral mucosal lesions. This systematic review evaluated how clinically relevant visual information-including color, texture, morphology, borders, and spatial patterns-is represented by AI systems and assessed performance, validation, explainability, human comparison, and clinical translation. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Google Scholar were searched for studies directly analyzing conventional white-light clinical photographs. Risk of bias was assessed with PROBAST + AI, and certainty with Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation-based approaches. Fifty-three studies were included, 30 published in 2025-2026. Forty-six used implicit deep-learning visual representations, three multimodal vision-language models, two explicit color analyses, and two explicit texture analyses. Thirty-one studies primarily addressed image-level diagnostic classification/recognition, 15 spatial detection/localization or lesion delineation, six screening/triage/referral or biopsy-oriented decision support, and one longitudinal malignant-transformation prediction. Six used independent external cohorts and five compared AI with human readers. Methodological concerns were frequent, no sufficiently coherent group supported meta-analysis, and certainty remained limited across evidence bodies. Current evidence therefore supports technical feasibility rather than established clinical effectiveness, with translation requiring stronger patient-level independence, external validation, prospective multicenter evaluation, and evidence of clinical benefit.
zh_abstract: [欧洲口腔科学杂志] 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地应用于常规口腔照片，以对口腔黏膜病变进行识别、分类、定位、分割和风险评估。本系统综述评估了AI系统如何表征具有临床意义的视觉信息（包括颜色、纹理、形态、边界和空间模式），并评估其性能、验证、可解释性、与人类的比较及临床转化情况。检索了PubMed、Embase、Scopus和Google Scholar中直接分析常规白光临床照片的研究。采用PROBAST + AI评估偏倚风险，并采用基于GRADE（推荐分级评估、制定与评价）的方法评估证据确定性。共纳入53项研究，其中30项发表于2025—2026年。46项使用隐式深度学习视觉表征，3项使用多模态视觉-语言模型，2项使用显式颜色分析，2项使用显式纹理分析。31项研究主要针对图像层面的诊断分类/识别，15项针对空间检测/定位或病变勾画，6项针对筛查/分诊/转诊或以活检为导向的决策支持，1项针对纵向恶性转化预测。6项使用独立的外部队列，5项将AI与人类阅片者进行了比较。方法学问题常见，没有任何足够一致的研究组可支持meta分析，各证据体的确定性仍然有限。因此，目前的证据支持的是技术可行性，而非已确立的临床有效性；要实现临床转化，需要更强的患者层面独立性、外部验证、前瞻性多中心评估以及临床获益的证据。

title: Evidence of limited biases in probed language-based assessments.
source: PubMed · Journal of psychopathology and clinical science
zh_title: 探究式语言评估中偏倚有限的证据
summary: 基于1260名参与者的开放式心理健康描述，用LLM嵌入加岭回归预测抑郁和焦虑症状严重度（r>.60），并检验其是否存在系统性偏倚。
key_points: 1260人开放式描述与PHQ-9、GAD-7对照
LLM嵌入+岭回归，预测r>.60
检验不同人群间的系统性偏倚
reason: 心理健康LLM评估含公平性分析，样本中等，无外部验证
abstract: [Journal of psychopathology and clinical science] Large language models enable increasingly accurate language-based assessments (LBAs) of psychopathology. As these tools are more widely deployed in real-world settings, a critical question emerges: Do these tools work equally well for everyone? We examined whether probed LBAs, in which individuals respond to open-ended mental health questions in their own words, exhibit systematic biases that could undermine their clinical utility. We collected open-ended mental health descriptions from 1,260 participants alongside validated depression (Patient Health Questionnaire-9) and anxiety (Generalized Anxiety Disorder Scale-7) scores. We converted these descriptions to numeric representations using large-language-model-generated embeddings and applied ridge regression to predict symptom severity, achieving strong predictive accuracy (r > .60). We then examined whether assessment differences were systematically associated with sociodemographic factors (gender, age, education, employment, and income) or linguistic characteristics. Our analysis revealed limited evidence of demographic or linguistic bias: Most variables showed minimal association with assessment errors (i.e., the absolute differences between the LBAs and self-reports). However, higher depression and anxiety severity were associated with larger absolute assessment differences (standardized β = .193, p = .038; β = .252, p = .003). We explored mitigation strategies, finding that downsampling training data eliminated the bias for depression and anxiety. Our findings indicate that probed LBAs exhibit limited bias overall, particularly regarding sociodemographic equity. However, the observed severity-related pattern highlights a fundamental challenge. zh_abstract: [Journal of psychopathology and clinical science] 大型语言模型使基于语言的精神病理学评估（language-based assessments, LBAs）越来越准确。随着这些工具在现实环境中得到更广泛的应用，一个关键问题随之出现：这些工具对每个人的效果是否同样好？我们考察了探究式LBAs（即个体用自己的话回答开放式心理健康问题）是否存在可能损害其临床实用性的系统性偏差。我们收集了1,260名参与者的开放式心理健康描述，以及经过验证的抑郁（患者健康问卷-9）和焦虑（广泛性焦虑障碍量表-7）评分。我们使用大型语言模型生成的嵌入将这些描述转换为数值表示，并应用岭回归预测症状严重程度，取得了较高的预测准确度（r > .60）。随后我们考察了评估差异是否与社会人口学因素（性别、年龄、教育、就业和收入）或语言特征存在系统性关联。分析显示，人口学或语言偏差的证据有限：大多数变量与评估误差（即LBAs与自我报告之间的绝对差异）的关联极小。然而，更高的抑郁和焦虑严重程度与更大的绝对评估差异相关（标准化β = .193，p = .038；β = .252，p = .003）。我们探索了缓解策略，发现对训练数据进行降采样可消除抑郁和焦虑方面的偏差。我们的研究结果表明，探究式LBAs总体上表现出的偏差有限，尤其是在社会人口学公平性方面。然而，所观察到的与严重程度相关的模式凸显了一个根本性挑战。(PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved)。

title: SeqSol-FECS: An Integrated Deep Learning and Structural Modeling Framework for Protein Solubility Engineering.

abstract: [Biomacromolecules] Escherichia coli is widely used as a workhorse for heterologous protein expression. However, insoluble protein expression is frequently encountered. The mechanisms underlying protein solubility remain incompletely understood, limiting the effectiveness of current protein solubility engineering strategies. Here, SeqSol, a sequence-level solubility prediction model capable of prioritizing single-amino-acid substitutions through WT-mutant rescoring, was developed using 71,425 proteins. SeqSol achieved an accuracy of 75.8% and an AUC of 0.840 on an independent test set and correctly identified experimentally validated solubility-enhancing mutations from diverse proteins. To minimize the risk of activity loss, candidate mutation sites were prioritized according to conformational flexibility, relative solvent accessibility, and evolutionary conservation before solubility engineering. Using only 30 experimentally tested mutations, the resulting SeqSol-FECS framework increased the solubility of two industrial enzymes from 56.18% and 10.53% to over 95%, respectively, while maintaining their specific activities. SeqSol-FECS provides an efficient strategy for enzyme solubility engineering and biomanufacturing applications.
zh_abstract: [Biomacromolecules] 大肠杆菌被广泛用作异源蛋白表达的主力宿主。然而，不溶性蛋白表达经常出现。蛋白质溶解度背后的机制仍未被完全阐明，限制了现有蛋白质溶解度工程策略的效果。在此，我们利用71,425个蛋白质开发了SeqSol，这是一种序列水平的溶解度预测模型，能够通过野生型-突变体重新评分对单氨基酸替换进行优先排序。SeqSol在独立测试集上的准确率为75.8%，AUC为0.840，并能正确识别来自多种蛋白质的、经实验验证的提高溶解度的突变。为尽量降低活性丧失的风险，在进行溶解度工程之前，根据构象柔性、相对溶剂可及性和进化保守性对候选突变位点进行了优先排序。仅通过30个经实验测试的突变，所得的SeqSol-FECS框架就将两种工业酶的溶解度分别从56.18%和10.53%提高到95%以上，同时保持了其比活性。SeqSol-FECS为酶溶解度工程和生物制造应用提供了一种高效策略。

title: Impact of training data on deep learning-based RNA 3D structure quality assessment.
zh_title: 训练数据对深度学习RNA三维结构质量评估的影响
summary: 对三种RNA 3D结构质量评估模型进行跨数据集重训练分析，并构建新数据集RNA3DQA，在RNA-Puzzles上评估。
key_points: 系统比较模型架构与训练数据的贡献
新建RNA3DQA数据集

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Accurate reference-free assessment of predicted RNA 3D structures is essential for large-scale RNA modeling, yet the impact of training data on deep learning-based quality predictors remains poorly understood. Here, we present a systematic cross-training analysis of three deep learning predictors for RNA 3D structure quality assessment, each originally developed on distinct training sets. By retraining each predictor on alternative (nonnative) datasets-including RNA3DQA, a new set created specifically for this project-and evaluating performance on independent RNA-Puzzles benchmarks, we systematically assess the relative contributions of model architecture and training data composition. Our results reveal pronounced differences in cross-dataset generalization, with predictors often performing better when trained on nonnative datasets than on their native ones. Notably, the impact of the training datasets varied across predictors, with RNA3DQA yielding the overall best accuracy and ranking stability results specifically for the ARES model. Native training sets yielded better performance for RNA3DCNN and lociPARSE. These findings demonstrate that the characteristics of the training data play a dominant, model-dependent role in shaping the performance and robustness of reference-free RNA 3D structure quality assessment methods. We conclude with practical recommendations for designing transferable training datasets and for benchmarking deep learning-based quality predictors in RNA structural bioinformatics.

title: Artificial intelligence triages chest radiographs: Optimising diagnostic workflow efficiency in hospital settings.
zh_title: AI胸片分诊：优化医院诊断流程效率
summary: 叙述性综述纳入12项研究，AI胸片分诊可缩短报告周转时间，但对下游诊断和患者结局的改善证据不足。
key_points: 纳入2021年后获批的CXR分诊软件研究12项
多项设计报告报告周转时间缩短，含一项大型RCT
下游诊断与患者结局改善证据有限
reason: 叙述性综述，综述上限；含RCT但结局证据有限
abstract: [Radiography (London, England : 1995)] This narrative review assesses the impact of artificial intelligence (AI)-driven chest radiograph (CXR) triage on the efficiency and accuracy of diagnostic workflows in hospital radiology departments. It includes regulatory-approved CXR triage software introduced since 2021 and evaluates key metrics such as sensitivity and report turnaround time in both real-world and simulated clinical environments. Twelve peer-reviewed studies, including single-centre and multicentre investigations across nine countries, were synthesised. AI-driven CXR triage detected selected critical abnormalities and prioritised urgent cases, with reductions in report turnaround time reported across workflow simulations, retrospective evaluations, prospective studies, and one large randomised controlled trial. However, evidence of improved downstream diagnosis or patient outcomes remains limited. Current evidence supports the potential clinical value of AI-driven CXR triage as adjuncts to radiologists and radiographers in hospital settings, demonstrating meaningful improvements in diagnostic efficiency and workflow performance. Continued large-scale, real-world validation, alongside attention to ethical, educational, and integration factors, is needed to support safe and sustainable adoption in radiographic practice. The findings of this review offer valuable insights to inform clinical workflows in hospitals worldwide, particularly those managing substantial CXR caseloads. AI-driven CXR triage should support the interpretation by reporting practitioners. Safe implementation requires local validation, integration with existing workflows, clear governance, staff education, and ongoing monitoring of diagnostic accuracy, reporting efficiency, and downstream patient outcomes. Because faster reporting does not necessarily accelerate diagnosis or treatment, adoption should be supported by coordinated pathway redesign and continued human oversight.
zh_abstract: [Radiography (London, England : 1995)] 本叙述性综述评估了人工智能（AI）驱动的胸部X线片（CXR）分诊对医院放射科诊断工作流程效率和准确性的影响。综述纳入了2021年以来推出的、经监管批准的CXR分诊软件，并评估了真实世界和模拟临床环境中的敏感度和报告周转时间等关键指标。综合分析了十二项经同行评议的研究，包括来自九个国家的单中心和多中心研究。AI驱动的CXR分诊能够检出所选的危急异常并对紧急病例进行优先排序，在工作流程模拟、回顾性评估、前瞻性研究和一项大型随机对照试验中均报告了报告周转时间的缩短。然而，关于改善下游诊断或患者结局的证据仍然有限。目前的证据支持AI驱动的CXR分诊作为医院环境中放射科医师和放射技师辅助工具的潜在临床价值，显示出诊断效率和工作流程表现的显著改善。需要持续开展大规模真实世界验证，并关注伦理、教育和整合方面的因素，以支持其在放射成像实践中的安全、可持续应用。本综述的发现为全球医院的临床工作流程提供了有价值的见解，尤其适用于CXR工作量大的医院。AI驱动的CXR分诊应辅助报告人员的判读。安全实施需要本地验证、与现有工作流程整合、明确的治理、人员培训，以及对诊断准确性、报告效率和下游患者结局的持续监测。由于更快的报告不一定能加速诊断或治疗，应通过协调的路径再设计和持续的人工监督来支持其应用。

title: Target Recoverability under Selective Labels: A Failure Mode in ECG-Based Acute Coronary Syndrome Prediction
zh_title: 选择性标签下的目标可恢复性：基于心电图的急性冠脉综合征预测失效模式
summary: 形式化选择性标签下模型输入无法检测的病例造成的偏差，并在ECG预测ACS中，用ECG基础模型实证研究。
key_points: 诊断仅在被检测患者中被观察到
不可检测病例可使关系在未检测者中失效甚至反转
仅用可检测病例训练的模型仍有信息量
reason: 预印本，涉及ECG基础模型与偏差机制，方法论有价值
abstract: Medical machine learning models often learn from diagnoses observed only in patients clinicians chose to test. The biases of such selective labels are well known, but less understood is what happens when a diagnosis includes cases the model's inputs cannot detect. Because testing decisions draw on information the model does not see, these cases can appear predictable among tested patients, producing relationships that fail, and can even reverse, among the untested. We formalize this mechanism and show in simulations that it worsens as testing becomes more selective or undetectable cases more common, while models trained only on detectable cases remain informative. We empirically study electrocardiogram (ECG)-based prediction of acute coronary syndrome (ACS), which is confirmed only by invasive testing and whose subtypes differ in how clearly they appear on the ECG. Three ECG foundation models fine-tuned on revascularization, our ACS proxy, performed well among catheterized patients (AUROC 0.740-0.770) but worse than chance for 30-day major adverse cardiovascular events among untested patients (AUROC 0.381-0.478). Models trained on ECG-visible subtypes retained discrimination (AUROC 0.680-0.709), whereas a model trained on unstable angina, which can occur without ECG changes, was inversely related to risk (AUROC 0.310). Under selective labels, effective learning therefore requires prediction targets that can be inferred from the model's inputs and evaluation in the intended deployment population, which often extends beyond the patients who were tested.
zh_abstract: 医学机器学习模型常常从仅在临床医生选择检测的患者中观察到的诊断中学习。此类选择性标签的偏倚已广为人知，但当诊断包含模型输入无法检测到的病例时会发生什么，则了解较少。由于检测决策依据的是模型看不到的信息，这些病例在已检测患者中可能显得可预测，从而产生在未检测患者中失效、甚至反转的关系。我们将这一机制形式化，并通过模拟表明，随着检测选择性增强或无法检测的病例更为常见，该问题会加剧，而仅基于可检测病例训练的模型仍具有信息价值。我们以心电图（ECG）预测急性冠脉综合征（ACS）为实证研究对象：ACS 仅能通过有创检查确诊，其各亚型在心电图上的表现清晰程度不同。三种 ECG 基础模型以血运重建（我们的 ACS 代理指标）进行微调，在接受导管检查的患者中表现良好（AUROC 0.740-0.770），但在未检测患者中对 30 天主要不良心血管事件的预测表现差于随机（AUROC 0.381-0.478）。基于 ECG 可见亚型训练的模型保持了区分能力（AUROC 0.680-0.709），而基于不稳定型心绞痛（可在无 ECG 改变的情况下发生）训练的模型则与风险呈反向关系（AUROC 0.310）。因此，在选择性标签条件下，有效的学习需要能够从模型输入推断出的预测目标，并需在预期部署人群中进行评估，而该人群往往超出接受检测的患者范围。

title: BioLT: Streaming Biosignal Modeling
zh_title: BioLT：流式生物信号建模
summary: 提出流式仅解码器框架BioLT，可将窗口级特征提取器或预训练生物信号基础模型扩展为处理长时、不连续的ECG/PPG/EEG流。
key_points: 以窗口间隔时间作为显式输入通道
固定大小压缩记忆库，复杂度随时长线性
可适配现有生物信号基础模型
reason: 预印本，长时生理信号基础模型方法有新意，命中偏好上调
abstract: Clinical biosignals such as ECG, PPG, and EEG are increasingly acquired as hours-long streams from bedside monitors and wearables, yet existing analysis pipelines almost universally operate on isolated short windows of around 10 seconds and cannot process the long, irregular, frequently interrupted signals. We introduce BioLT, a streaming decoder-only framework for long-context biosignal modeling that turns any window-level feature extractor or pretrained biosignal foundation model into a streaming model. BioLT combines (i) a discontinuity-aware encoding that exposes the inter-window elapsed time as an explicit input channel, so that the decoder can learn to model these gaps as clinically meaningful information, and (ii) a fixed-size compressed memory bank supervised with cumulative summary statistics, which keeps both training and inference linear in the recording length while preserving long-range context. We evaluate on CPSC-2021, VitalDB, MC-MED, and CHB-MIT for arrhythmia, sepsis, and seizure detection and for forecasting up to 20 minutes ahead, using domain features and embeddings from six biosignal foundation models. Across 21 dataset-feature settings, BioLT achieves the highest detection AUROC in 15 and the highest 20-minute forecasting AUROC in 13 settings, and shows consistent performance gains over state-of-the-art snapshot foundation-model embeddings. These highlight the importance of modeling how streaming biosignal representations evolve over time, beyond improving window-level representations alone.

title: Rapid generation of antibody conformational ensembles using machine learning
zh_title: Cadense：用机器学习快速生成抗体构象系综
summary: 提出生成式框架Cadense，可从序列生成抗体Fv结构系综，使分布匹配分子动力学结果，并将耗时从数天缩短至数秒。
key_points: 生成匹配MD构象与生物物理性质分布的系综
可恢复同一抗体的apo与holo构象
面向抗体药物发现中柔性CDR环建模
reason: 有新意的生成方法，药物发现方向加分；预印本证据有限
abstract: We introduce Cadense, a generative framework for antibody ensemble prediction that produces diverse Fv structures from sequence, informed by conformational dynamics. While a valuable resource, static structure prediction provides only a single snapshot of dynamic proteins, whose motions influence their binding and other properties. This is particularly relevant for antibodies, an important class of molecules for drug discovery, where flexible complementarity determining region (CDR) loops are difficult to model with static approaches. Cadense addresses this gap by generating ensembles that match conformational and biophysical property distributions from molecular dynamics (MD), while reducing the computational burden from days of simulation to seconds of generation. We show Cadense ensembles can recover both apo and holo conformations of the same antibody and serve as effective input to physics-based docking, capturing the conformational flexibility important to properly model antibody antigen interactions. Together, these results establish Cadense as a useful tool for antibody conformational ensemble generation with the promise to enable faster, dynamics-aware antibody design.
zh_abstract: 我们介绍 Cadense，这是一种用于抗体构象系综预测的生成式框架，能够在构象动力学的指导下从序列生成多样化的 Fv 结构。静态结构预测虽然是一种有价值的资源，但对于动态蛋白质只能提供单一快照，而其运动会影响结合及其他性质。这对抗体尤为重要，抗体是药物发现中的一类重要分子，其灵活的互补决定区（CDR）环难以用静态方法建模。Cadense 通过生成与分子动力学（MD）所得构象和生物物理性质分布相匹配的系综来弥补这一空白，同时将计算负担从数天的模拟缩减至数秒的生成。我们表明，Cadense 系综能够还原同一抗体的 apo 和 holo 两种构象，并可作为基于物理的对接的有效输入，捕捉对于正确建模抗体-抗原相互作用十分重要的构象灵活性。总之，这些结果表明 Cadense 是用于生成抗体构象系综的有用工具，有望实现更快速、兼顾动力学的抗体设计。

title: π-SPECFormer: A Mass Spectrometry-based Foundation Model for Decoding the Dark Proteome
zh_title: π-SPECFormer：解码暗蛋白质组的质谱基础模型
summary: 在2.91亿张质谱图上预训练的基础模型，可迁移至从头肽测序、谱图聚类和修饰检测，并优于任务特定基线。
key_points: 自监督加PSM引导的两阶段预训练
迁移至三类下游任务
报告优于任务特定基线
reason: 大规模预训练基础模型有基线对比，但为预印本，权重开放未知
abstract: In mass-spectrometry-based proteomics, a substantial proportion of acquired spectra remain unidentified, concealing a vast reservoir of biological variations commonly termed the "dark proteome", potentially obscuring sequence mutations, non-canonical peptides and post-translational modifications. Existing deep-learning methods largely rely on supervised training with peptide-spectrum matches (PSMs), limiting their ability to learn from the much larger pool of unannotated spectra. Here we introduce {pi}-SPECFormer, a mass-spectrometry foundation model pre-trained on 291 million spectra through a two-stage framework that combines self-supervised and PSMs-guided representation learning. {pi}-SPECFormer transfers effectively to de novo peptide sequencing, spectrum clustering and modification detection, consistently outperforming task-specific baselines. When applied to proteomic profiles from 103 individuals with lung adenocarcinoma, the model identified nine high-confidence mutated peptides, including six that were absent from the reference databases. {pi}-SPECFormer thus enables unbiased decoding of molecular complexity beyond the boundaries of the canonical proteome.

title: Can Agentic Systems Close the Gap in Radiology with Production AI Tools?
zh_title: 智能体系统能否借助已获批工具弥合放射学差距
summary: 提出放射学智能体框架，由编排器调用模块化工具生成结构化报告，并用FDA已批准设备的工具评估其能力。
key_points: 编排器标准化调用模块化工具
工具目录来自FDA批准的放射AI设备
在大型多模态报告语料上模拟报告生成
reason: 智能体加放射报告方向相关，但为模拟评估的预印本
abstract: Radiology AI has developed along two paths: specialized models that perform well on narrow tasks but cover few clinical findings, and generalist models that address a broader range of tasks but remain prone to hallucination and inaccurate measurements. Combining the two through agentic systems offers a route towards comprehensive radiology reporting, but published systems are tied to one modality or body part. We describe a radiology agentic framework that standardizes how an orchestrator calls modular tools to produce a structured report, and use it to measure what such a system can do with the tools from FDA-cleared radiology AI devices. Report generation is simulated on a large multi-modality report corpus, with the orchestrator given either a catalog of finding classes consolidated from the cleared devices, each available on the modalities it is cleared for, or an unlimited catalog in which any class can be requested, and planning either from the clinical indication or from the target report. Tool outputs are simulated from the reference report, so the comparison isolates tool availability and orchestration from tool error. With the cleared catalog and the indication alone, the orchestrator recovers under a third of the clinically actionable findings; recovery improves substantially with the unlimited catalog, and further when the plan is written from the target report. Attributing every missed finding to a cause shows that most are classes no cleared device offers for the study's modality, and that a third are classes or tools that were offered and not called. Adding the most frequently missing tools closes most of the gap to the unlimited catalog on held-out reports, whereas a smaller orchestrator with the unlimited catalog gives up the whole gain. Tool availability and effective orchestration are thus complementary constraints on comprehensive AI-assisted radiology reporting.
zh_abstract: 放射学人工智能沿两条路径发展：专用模型在狭窄任务上表现良好，但涵盖的临床发现很少；通用模型可处理更广泛的任务，但仍易出现幻觉和测量不准确。通过智能体（agentic）系统将二者结合，为实现全面的放射学报告提供了一条途径，但已发表的系统均局限于单一模态或单一身体部位。我们描述了一个放射学智能体框架，该框架规范了协调器（orchestrator）调用模块化工具以生成结构化报告的方式，并用它来衡量此类系统借助美国 FDA 批准的放射学 AI 设备中的工具所能完成的工作。我们在一个大型多模态报告语料库上模拟报告生成：协调器获得的要么是由已获批设备整合而成的发现类别目录（每个类别仅在其获批的模态上可用），要么是可请求任意类别的无限目录；规划则要么基于临床适应证，要么基于目标报告。工具输出根据参考报告模拟，因此该比较将工具可用性和协调能力与工具误差区分开来。在使用已获批目录且仅依据适应证时，协调器仅能找回不到三分之一的具有临床可操作性的发现；使用无限目录后找回率显著提高，当计划基于目标报告撰写时进一步提高。将每个遗漏的发现归因于具体原因后发现，大多数是该研究模态下没有任何已获批设备提供的类别，另有三分之一是已提供但未被调用的类别或工具。在保留的报告上，加入最常缺失的工具可弥合与无限目录之间的大部分差距，而使用较小的协调器配合无限目录则会丧失全部增益。因此，工具可用性与有效的协调能力是对全面的 AI 辅助放射学报告互补的两项约束。

title: ICare-DT: a digital twin for continuous forecasting of intensive care patients
zh_title: ICare-DT：重症患者连续预测的数字孪生
summary: 基于Transformer的数字孪生，每小时更新潜在患者状态，在eICU训练并在MIMIC-IV上评估生命体征预测。
key_points: 14万余次eICU住院用于训练
后续预测AUROC提升0.073至0.153
无需重训在第二数据库多数设置保持增益
reason: 跨数据库外部评估、样本大，但为预印本且回顾性
abstract: Digital twins of intensive care patients should update forecasts from new data and predict treatment responses, but few studies test whether routine records support either. We propose ICare-DT, a Transformer-based twin that updates a latent patient state hourly from new measurements without retraining. We trained it on 140,473 eICU-CRD stays to forecast vital signs crossing their training-set means. On test data, later forecasts beat the twin's own hour-6 forecasts of the same windows in all 12 settings (+0.073 to +0.153 AUROC). On validation data, controls that withheld or swapped the new hours traced the gain to the patient's own measurements. Without refitting, the model kept its gain on a second database (8 of 9 settings, +0.025 to +0.114 AUROC) in a prespecified evaluation of the previously analyzed MIMIC-IV test split. Refitted within MIMIC-IV, a twin state fine-tuned on clinical endpoints gave gradient boosting a significant gain for acute kidney injury (+0.0035 AUROC; hypotension +0.0010, not significant). To test response prediction, we built a benchmark that replaces the treatments in real records with simulated doses and injects responses of known size, visible only at measurement times. Ridge models supervised with injected effects recovered them from real records only through frequently measured variables (heart rate) read at their measurement times. We asked standard learners to predict these effects for a dosing regime no patient had received. No standard learner outperformed predicting zero effect at an out-of-support query. When told how the simulated responses were generated, a separate learner recovered the effects from the same records without seeing their true values (R2 0.30 to 0.40 at one effect size). Routine records support forecasts that improve with each patient's new data, and our benchmark is a testbed for models that learn how responses are generated.

title: Can General-Purpose Generative AI Supply Training Data for Medical Vision Models? A Multimodal Retrospective Study
zh_title: 通用生成式AI能否为医学视觉模型提供训练数据？
summary: 回顾性研究评估通用图像生成模型Nano Banana合成影像用于训练、增强与审计，覆盖四种模态并做外部验证。
key_points: 胸片、眼底、CT仅用合成图训练并外部验证
颈动脉超声以合成数据做亚组增强
仅合成训练肺炎AUROC为0.877
reason: 多模态含外部验证，但为预印本回顾性研究
abstract: Background: Well-annotated, diverse medical imaging datasets remain a major constraint for vision-based medical AI. We evaluated Nano Banana, a general-purpose image generation and editing model, as a source of synthetic medical images for model training, subgroup augmentation, and model auditing. Methods: In this retrospective study across four imaging modalities, chest radiography, fundus photography, and CT models were trained only on synthetic images and externally validated on real-world data against real-data-trained models. Carotid ultrasound models were trained on a private Human Phenotype Project cohort (aged 40-75 years) with and without synthetic augmentation. Clinicians rated image plausibility. Evaluation used AUROC, AUPR, calibration, and decision curve analysis. Findings: Synthetic-only models achieved AUROCs of 0.877 (95% CI 0.843-0.910) for pneumonia (n=14863), 0.963 (0.948-0.975) for retinal detachment (n=1149), and 0.711 (0.600-0.823) for renal calculus (n=4122), comparable to real-data-trained models, but their calibration and net benefit were not consistently more favorable. With mixed synthetic-real training, a carotid ultrasound model produced an ordinal vascular age index that stratified 633 external subjects into subgroups differing in BMI and glucose (both p<0.01), linking vascular aging to cardiometabolic health. To stress-test shortcut learning, editing a moderate tessellated pattern into fundus photographs reduced the true-class probability for central serous chorioretinopathy from 0.996 to 0.822. Clinician-guided editing raised low-quality CT plausibility from 3.10/5 to 4.30/5. Interpretation: Synthetic data can complement real data in model training, subgroup representation, and model testing via controlled editing, but its clinical value should be assessed with calibration, decision curve analysis, and clinician review, not discrimination alone.
zh_abstract: 【背景】标注完善、多样化的医学影像数据集仍是基于视觉的医学 AI 的主要制约因素。我们评估了通用图像生成与编辑模型 Nano Banana 作为合成医学图像来源，用于模型训练、亚组增强和模型审核的价值。【方法】在这项涵盖四种影像模态的回顾性研究中，胸部X线、眼底照相和CT模型仅用合成图像训练，并在真实世界数据上进行外部验证，与真实数据训练的模型比较。颈动脉超声模型在私有的人类表型项目（Human Phenotype Project）队列（年龄40-75岁）上训练，分别采用和不采用合成数据增强。临床医生对图像的真实可信度进行评分。评估采用AUROC、AUPR、校准和决策曲线分析。【结果】仅用合成数据训练的模型，其AUROC在肺炎（n=14863）为0.877（95% CI 0.843-0.910），视网膜脱离（n=1149）为0.963（0.948-0.975），肾结石（n=4122）为0.711（0.600-0.823），与真实数据训练的模型相当，但其校准和净获益并非始终更优。采用合成与真实数据混合训练时，颈动脉超声模型产生了有序的血管年龄指数，将633名外部受试者分层为BMI和血糖不同的亚组（均p<0.01），将血管衰老与心脏代谢健康联系起来。为对捷径学习进行压力测试，在眼底照片中编辑加入中等程度的镶嵌图案，使中心性浆液性脉络膜视网膜病变的真实类别概率从0.996降至0.822。临床医生指导下的编辑使低质量CT的可信度从3.10/5提高到4.30/5。【结论】合成数据可在模型训练、亚组代表性以及通过可控编辑进行模型测试方面补充真实数据，但其临床价值应通过校准、决策曲线分析和临床医生审阅来评估，而不能仅依据区分度。

title: EndoSCOP-V: A Multi-Turn Video Understanding Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Models in Endoscopy Reporting and Clinical Reasoning
zh_title: EndoSCOP-V：内镜报告与临床推理的多轮视频理解评测框架
summary: 提出含1,307段真实内镜视频、20,274个问答轮次的多轮评测框架，问题由医生填写的结构化报告确定性生成。
key_points: 1,307段内镜/结肠镜视频，共63.2小时
问答源自医生审核的1,033个模板
评估多模态模型的视频理解与临床推理
reason: 新的内镜视频多模态基准，规模可观，预印本
abstract: Endoscopic diagnosis unfolds over native video, where a single positive finding during traversal of the gastrointestinal tract sets off a multi-minute chain of reasoning over location, morphology, severity and intervention. Existing endoscopy multimodal benchmarks test only static images or single-disease videos, which miss the temporal and clinical reasoning that real-world reporting demands. We introduce EndoSCOP-V, a video-grounded multi-turn evaluation framework for structured endoscopy reporting and clinical reasoning. It contains 1,307 real-world endoscopy and colonoscopy videos (63.2 h; 97% 1080p) averaging about 174 s. Its 20,274 question-answer turns are instantiated deterministically from clinician-filled structured endoscopy-reporting EHRs, so no per-case annotation is synthetic or LLM-rephrased. They come from 1,033 clinician-reviewed templates, about 18 per disease, that span a clinically aligned 9-task x 30-sub-task reporting taxonomy over 54 World Endoscopy Organization (WEO) MST 3.0 diseases. 22% of procedures carry co-existing pathologies, up to six per case. A Markovian context-pruned oracle-forcing protocol evaluates the dialogue turn by turn, injecting the gold answer before each subsequent turn so that per-turn reasoning is isolated from cascading dialogue errors. A panel of 15 board-certified endoscopists sets a 78% strict-accuracy baseline on 1,500 questions. Across 14 open-weight LMMs, the best 27B-class model reaches 59.8% strict accuracy, falling to 53.4% once format-trivial disease-rejection items are excluded. On a between-subjects spot-check, the best of 3 frontier proprietary models trails the clinician panel by 23 pp on strict NDR accuracy. Sub-task analysis reveals consistent gaps in quantitative measurement, multi-variable grading and intervention reasoning on long-horizon video. Data: Hugging Face (EndoSCOP-V). Code: GitHub (abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V).
zh_abstract: 内镜诊断是在原生视频上展开的：在穿行消化道的过程中，一个阳性发现会引发持续数分钟、围绕位置、形态、严重程度和干预措施的推理链。现有内镜多模态基准仅测试静态图像或单一疾病视频，忽略了真实世界报告所需的时间性和临床推理。我们提出 EndoSCOP-V，一个基于视频、多轮次的结构化内镜报告与临床推理评估框架。它包含 1,307 个真实世界的内镜和结肠镜视频（63.2 小时；97% 为 1080p），平均约 174 秒。其 20,274 个问答轮次由临床医生填写的结构化内镜报告电子病历确定性地实例化生成，因此没有任何逐病例标注是合成的或经大语言模型改写的。这些问答来自 1,033 个经临床医生审核的模板，每种疾病约 18 个，涵盖与临床一致的 9 项任务 × 30 项子任务的报告分类体系，覆盖 54 种世界内镜组织（WEO）MST 3.0 疾病。22% 的操作伴有并存病变，每例最多六种。一种马尔可夫式上下文裁剪的黄金答案强制（oracle-forcing）协议逐轮评估对话，在每个后续轮次之前注入标准答案，从而使每轮推理与级联的对话错误相隔离。由 15 名获得委员会认证的内镜医师组成的小组在 1,500 个问题上设定了 78% 的严格准确率基线。在 14 个开放权重大型多模态模型中，最佳的 27B 级模型达到 59.8% 的严格准确率，在排除形式上简单的疾病排除题后降至 53.4%。在一项受试者间抽查中，3 个前沿专有模型中最好的一个在严格 NDR 准确率上落后临床医生小组 23 个百分点。子任务分析显示，在长时程视频上，模型在定量测量、多变量分级和干预推理方面存在持续差距。数据：Hugging Face（EndoSCOP-V）。代码：GitHub（abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V）。

title: BAPLe++: Cross-Model Transferability and Prompt-Level Defense of Backdoors in Medical Foundation Models
zh_title: BAPLe++：医学基础模型后门的跨模型迁移与提示级防御
summary: 研究医学基础模型提示学习中后门的跨模型迁移性，并提出无需重训骨干的提示级修复防御。
key_points: 首次研究提示式后门的跨模型迁移
提出CAD与BAD两项度量
提出提示级防御，无需重训骨干
reason: 医学基础模型安全的新方法预印本，有新意但证据有限，基础模型方向上调
abstract: Medical foundation models (Med-FMs) are increasingly adapted to clinical tasks through prompt learning, which tunes a small set of prompt tokens while the backbone remains frozen. Recent work has shown that this efficiency introduces a vulnerability: jointly optimizing learnable prompts and an imperceptible noise trigger during few-shot adaptation implants a backdoor that leaves clean performance intact but steers triggered inputs to an attacker-chosen class. Since prompts are compact and readily shared, this raises two questions: whether a backdoored prompt remains effective on a different Med-FM, and whether it can be repaired without retraining the backbone. We address both in BAPLe++. First, we present the first study of cross-model transferability of prompt-based backdoors, quantified by two proposed metrics, Clean Accuracy Difference (CAD) and Backdoor Accuracy Difference (BAD). Second, we propose DePLe (Defense via Prompt Learning), which uses the infected prompt as a fixed anchor and learns a new prompt on a small clean set that preserves the clean task while diverging from the compromised embedding region. Experiments on four Med-FMs and six chest X-ray and histopathology datasets show that backdoors transfer across models, but asymmetrically and in a dataset-dependent manner. Compared with four training-free input transformations, DePLe reduces backdoor accuracy more consistently while preserving, and in several settings improving, clean accuracy. Our code can be accessed on https://github.com/Ufaqkhan/Baple-Plus-Plus

title: TrialJev: Open-Weight Single Pass Eligibility Scoring for Patient Trial Screening
zh_title: TrialJev：开放权重的单次前向试验入排评分
summary: 基于LoRA适配的Qwen模型，单次前向给出患者-试验入选评分，在TREC 2022合成患者上准确率约81–82%。
key_points: 指针头避免自回归解码
推理耗时比生成式裁决快约2.5倍
reason: 试验匹配方向有新意，开放权重，但仅合成患者数据评估
abstract: Clinical trial screening requires assessing large numbers of patient-trial pairs to prioritize candidates for detailed eligibility review, often under restrictions on sharing patient records. We introduce TrialJev, an open-weight eligibility scorer that uses LoRA-adapted Qwen models and a pointer head to score natural-language answer options in a single forward pass, without autoregressive decoding. Trained on TREC Clinical Trials 2021 and evaluated on 6,975 eligible-or-excluded pairs from 50 unseen TREC 2022 synthetic patients, TrialJev achieves 80.97% (Qwen3.5-27B) and 81.84% (Qwen3.8-27B) accuracy, compared with 79.87% and 79.93% for LLMs fine-tuned on the same data to generate verdicts. In matched batch-1 measurements, verdict generation takes 2.45-2.70 times as long as the one-pass inference of TrialJev at 9B-27B. Under a common development-fitted decision correction, the two 27B TrialJev models reach 80.99% and 81.88% accuracy, compared with 81.28% for the proprietary hosted Jev API; paired confidence intervals include zero. TrialJev runs locally on a single GPU, requiring approximately 178 ms per pair at 27B, without transmitting patient text to an external model API. An A/B-logit ablation shows that avoiding decoding, rather than the pointer head alone, accounts for the measured efficiency advantage. TrialJev is intended for first-pass prioritization of candidate trials, complementing rather than replacing explanatory models and clinical review. Evaluation is limited to synthetic patients and implementation-specific timing, and clinical use has not been validated. Adapters, pointer heads, and model cards are released on Hugging Face.

title: Dataset Collections: Challenges of Large-Scale Data Aggregation in 3D Medical Image Datasets
zh_title: 数据集集合：三维医学影像大规模聚合的挑战
summary: 分析565k三维放射影像、1034个公开数据集的聚合集合中的溯源、重复与泄漏等问题，并提供实用资源。
key_points: 将数据集集合形式化为独立范式
指出复用传播、重复、泄漏与偏倚放大风险
覆盖565k影像、1034个公开数据集
reason: 大规模数据聚合风险分析，对基础模型训练有参考，预印本
abstract: The development of deep learning-based medical AI depends on high-quality annotated data. Yet, dataset creation remains constrained by the need for expert radiologist annotations, limiting curated datasets to relatively small cohorts. To overcome this limitation, recent efforts increasingly aggregate disparate public datasets into large-scale dataset collections. However, combining datasets at scale often obscures data provenance, introducing substantial risks of reuse propagation, unintended leakage, bias amplification and distorted data distributions. In this work, we study these problems on a massive collection of 565k 3D radiological images across 1034 public datasets and provide practical resources to address them. Firstly, we formalize dataset collections as a distinct paradigm in medical image analysis and characterize their structural challenges, including reuse propagation, duplication, and provenance fragmentation. Secondly, we perform a large-scale empirical study of duplication on this collection and demonstrate extensive exact and near-duplicate reuse across public datasets via perceptual hashing and manual tracing, identifying a lower bound of 118k duplicate pairs. We make the perceptual hashes publicly accessible for comparison through our website, providing researchers with a standardized reference for identifying potential overlaps and shared provenance. Thirdly, since hashing alone cannot detect all duplicates, we introduce MAP (Metadata for Aggregation and Provenance), a lightweight, portable metadata profile for documenting provenance, known overlaps, and deduplication decisions in dataset collections. Our contributions help dataset collections shift from coarse aggregations to reliable and provenance-aware data scaling mechanisms in medical image analysis. A web tool supporting our work is available at https://mic-dct.dkfz.de/.

title: Uncertainty, Not Concealment: A Mechanistic Reappraisal of Sycophancy in Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 不确定而非隐瞒：重新审视视觉语言模型谄媚现象的机制
summary: 在胸片上对四个VLM做探针、激活操控和二选一诊断，检验其是否内部察觉报告与影像冲突却隐瞒。
key_points: 线性探针可区分匹配与不匹配输入
操控冲突方向未能引出矛盾报告
结论倾向不确定而非刻意隐瞒
reason: VLM机制分析有新意，预印本，医疗RAG安全相关
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) in medical retrieval-augmented generation must be able to say when a retrieved report contradicts the X-ray, so understanding whether they can detect such conflicts is important for safe deployment. The sycophancy mask hypothesis holds that these models internally detect conflicts but refuse to report them, concealing a detected contradiction. We introduce a three-part diagnostic that separates concealment from uncertainty: representation probing, activation steering, and two-way forced choice. Across four instruction-tuned VLMs on chest X-rays, we confirm behavioral suppression of contradiction and find that a linear probe separates matched from mismatched inputs, beyond what a simple CLIP model achieves. Steering the learned conflict direction never elicits contradiction, and forcing a binary choice does not recover one; instead, cross-modal attention to the image drops on mismatched pairs. We conclude that these models fail to contradict because the mismatch registers as hedged, gated uncertainty rather than concealed knowledge, calling for re-grounding and uncertainty surfacing. Code is available at https://github.com/mohamed-eldagla/Uncertainty-Not-Concealment/.
zh_abstract: 在医学检索增强生成中，视觉-语言模型（VLM）必须能够指出所检索的报告何时与X线片相矛盾，因此了解它们能否检测此类冲突对于安全部署十分重要。“谄媚面具”假说认为，这些模型在内部检测到了冲突却拒绝报告，从而掩盖了已检测到的矛盾。我们提出一个由三部分组成的诊断方法，以区分掩盖与不确定性：表示探测、激活操控和二选一强制选择。在胸部X线片上对四个指令微调的VLM进行测试，我们证实了对矛盾的行为抑制，并发现线性探针能够区分匹配与不匹配的输入，其效果超过简单的CLIP模型。操控所学得的冲突方向从未引出矛盾表述，强制二选一也无法恢复矛盾表述；相反，在不匹配的配对上，对图像的跨模态注意力下降。我们得出结论：这些模型之所以未能提出矛盾，是因为不匹配被登记为含糊的、受门控的不确定性，而非被掩盖的已知信息，这需要重新建立依据（re-grounding）并显现不确定性。代码见 https://github.com/mohamed-eldagla/Uncertainty-Not-Concealment/。

title: A Clinical Evaluation of Conformal Prediction for Chest Radiograph Report Generation
zh_title: 胸片报告生成中保形预测的临床评估
summary: 提出CLARITY临床可接受性标准，收集放射科医生标注，评估保形预测与自动指标对临床相关错误的检测能力。
key_points: 区分有临床后果的错误与轻微偏差
采集放射科医生对MLLM报告的标注
常用可接受性代理指标难以发现临床错误
reason: 含专家标注与基准对照，但为预印本、证据有限
abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have improved automated radiology report generation, they remain prone to hallucinations, necessitating clinically meaningful risk-control methods. Conformal prediction (CP) provides statistical guarantees, yet existing CP approaches rely on uncalibrated automated extractors and fail to account for the clinical relevance of errors. We introduce clinical admissibility criteria (CLARITY), a framework for evaluating radiology reports that explicitly distinguishes clinically consequential errors from minor deviations. To eliminate reliance on automatic judges, we collected radiologist annotations of MLLM-generated reports using CLARITY. By benchmarking CP strategies and automatic evaluation metrics against these expert annotations, we demonstrate that commonly used admissibility proxies systematically fail to detect clinically relevant errors. Our findings reveal that automated admissibility judgments are largely decoupled from true clinical admissibility.
zh_abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）改进了放射学报告的自动生成，但它们仍易出现幻觉，因此需要具有临床意义的风险控制方法。保形预测（CP）可提供统计保证，但现有CP方法依赖未经校准的自动提取器，且未考虑错误的临床相关性。我们提出临床可接受性标准（CLARITY），这是一个用于评估放射学报告的框架，明确区分具有临床后果的错误与轻微偏差。为消除对自动评判器的依赖，我们使用CLARITY收集了放射科医师对MLLM生成报告的标注。通过以这些专家标注为基准评测CP策略和自动评估指标，我们证明常用的可接受性代理指标系统性地无法检测出临床相关错误。我们的研究结果表明，自动化的可接受性判断在很大程度上与真实的临床可接受性脱节。

title: ATLAS: A Multi-Procedure Benchmark and Context-Aware Model for Surgical Anatomy Segmentation
zh_title: ATLAS：多术式手术解剖分割基准与上下文感知模型
summary: 发布含121,018帧、覆盖14种术式41类的手术视频分割数据集ATLAS-120k，并提出上下文感知分割模型。
key_points: 100段手术视频，14种腹腔镜/机器人术式
标注结合人工、跟踪传播与外科医生审核
模型基于领域基础模型嵌入并加入上下文
reason: 大规模多术式手术分割数据集，但为预印本
abstract: Recognizing anatomical structures during minimally invasive surgery (MIS) could support intraoperative navigation and improve patient safety, but progress is limited by small, single-procedure datasets and by segmentation methods developed for natural scenes. This work addresses both limitations through a new dataset and model. First, we introduce ATLAS-120k, a clip-level semantic segmentation dataset of 121,018 annotated frames from 100 surgical videos, covering 14 laparoscopic and robot-assisted procedures and 41 classes. Annotations were created with a pipeline that combines manual labeling, tracker-based propagation, and review by surgeons. Second, we propose ATLAS (Anatomy Recognition with Context Learning using Foundation Representations), a video semantic segmentation model for surgical anatomy recognition. ATLAS builds on in-domain foundation-model embeddings and adds context queries for the procedure and surgical phase, together with query propagation between frames for short-term memory. ATLAS outperforms state-of-the-art natural-image and in-domain foundation models in both segmentation accuracy and temporal consistency, achieving a Dice score of 0.70 with ViT-L while running in real time at 76.2 FPS. Ablations show that the context queries improve accuracy and that query propagation improves temporal consistency. ATLAS also generalizes well, matching a dedicated model zero-shot on CholecSeg8k and improving phase recognition on AutoLaparo over SurgeNet initialization. The model weights, dataset annotations, and annotation tool are publicly available at https://github.com/TimJaspers0801/ATLAS.

title: Contrastive fine-tuning against stain and scanner bias improves robustness and downstream performance across pathology foundation models
zh_title: 针对染色与扫描仪偏差的对比微调提升病理基础模型稳健性
summary: 提出SPECTRA，用LoRA适配器和多扫描仪多染色配对WSI做对比微调，提升病理基础模型对扫描仪与染色偏差的稳健性及下游表现。
key_points: 模型无关的对比学习后训练框架
基于PLISM多扫描仪多染色配对数据
在PathoROB稳健性上有提升
reason: 病理基础模型稳健性新方法，有基线对比，但为预印本
abstract: Histopathology foundation models achieve strong performance across diverse downstream tasks, yet their representations have been shown to encode scanner- and site-specific biases, creating generalization gaps and potentially limiting real-world utility. We introduce SPECTRA (Scanner and Pathology Embedding Contrastive Tuning for Robust Alignment), a model-agnostic contrastive learning post-training framework which explicitly encourages scanner- and stain-robust representations, to optimize performance and generalization on downstream applications. Using parameter-efficient LoRA adapters trained on matched multi-scanner and multi-stain whole-slide images sourced from the PLISM dataset, our method aligns spatially corresponding regions across acquisition conditions (scanner, stain), using other locations within each candidate condition as negatives. SPECTRA improved PathoROB robustness index, gene-expression prediction on HEST, slide-level classification AUC on CPTAC, and held-out PLISM retrieval for every model. Overall tile-level classification on THUNDER also improved, with exceptions for segmentation and calibration tasks. We open-source our training and evaluation codebases and release adapters and model weights for selected backbones.
zh_abstract: 组织病理学基础模型在多种下游任务中表现出色，但已有研究表明，其表征会编码扫描仪和采集site特异性的偏倚，造成泛化差距，并可能限制其在真实世界中的实用性。我们提出了 SPECTRA（Scanner and Pathology Embedding Contrastive Tuning for Robust Alignment），这是一种与模型无关的对比学习后训练框架，可明确促使模型获得对扫描仪和染色稳健的表征，从而优化下游应用的性能和泛化能力。我们使用参数高效的 LoRA 适配器，在来自 PLISM 数据集的匹配的多扫描仪、多染色全切片图像上进行训练；该方法对不同采集条件（扫描仪、染色）下空间上对应的区域进行对齐，并将每个候选条件内的其他位置作为负样本。SPECTRA 使每个模型在 PathoROB 稳健性指数、HEST 上的基因表达预测、CPTAC 上的切片级分类 AUC 以及留出的 PLISM 检索任务中均得到提升。在 THUNDER 上，整体的图块级分类也有所改善，但分割和校准任务除外。我们开源了训练和评估代码库，并发布了所选骨干网络的适配器和模型权重。

title: Foundation Model Artificial Intelligence for Electrocardiogram Detection of Rheumatic Mitral Stenosis.
source: PubMed · medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
zh_title: ECG基础模型检测风湿性二尖瓣狭窄
summary: 微调ECG基础模型，用有限的ICD间接标签检测风湿性二尖瓣狭窄，外部验证AUROC为0.77–0.82。
key_points: 每折使用804例RMS阳性ECG微调
覆盖12导联、6导联和单导联，亚组表现相近
reason: 含外部验证且面向低资源场景，但样本与结局证据有限
abstract: [medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences] Rheumatic mitral stenosis (RMS) disproportionately affects low-resource settings where echocardiography is limited. We evaluated foundation model (FM) feasibility for RMS detection using limited, indirectly labeled ECGs. An ECG-FM was fine-tuned using 804 RMS-positive ECGs per fold and externally validated across clinical and wearable lead configurations. Internal AUROCs were 0.89, 0.87, and 0.87, for 12-Lead, 6-Lead, and 1-Lead respectively. External AUROCs were 0.82, 0.80, and 0.77. Performance remained comparable across demographic subgroups. FM fine-tuning enables RMS detection using limited ICD-derived labels, supporting further evaluation of reduced-lead ECG screening and echocardiography triage in resource-constrained settings.
zh_abstract: [medRxiv：健康科学预印本服务器] 风湿性二尖瓣狭窄（RMS）对资源匮乏地区的影响尤为严重，这些地区的超声心动图检查条件有限。我们评估了利用有限的、间接标注的心电图（ECG）开展基础模型（FM）检测 RMS 的可行性。每个折使用 804 份 RMS 阳性心电图对一个心电图基础模型（ECG-FM）进行微调，并在临床导联配置和可穿戴设备导联配置下进行外部验证。12 导联、6 导联和 1 导联的内部 AUROC 分别为 0.89、0.87 和 0.87；外部 AUROC 分别为 0.82、0.80 和 0.77。各人口学亚组的表现保持相当。基础模型微调能够利用有限的、源自 ICD 的标签实现 RMS 检测，支持在资源受限环境中进一步评估减少导联心电图筛查和超声心动图分诊。

title: PathXAI: Evidence-guided structured pathology reporting by transferable tissue segmentation
zh_title: PathXAI：基于可迁移组织分割的证据引导结构化病理报告
summary: PathXAI结合分割得到的组织信息与H&E图像生成结构化病理报告，在公开与私有队列上优于对比方法。
key_points: 分割在内部与外部测试Dice优于基线
评估1200例公开和151例私有病例
癌症家族匹配率比Qwen+H&E高4.4个百分点
reason: 病理报告生成预印本，含外部测试与私有队列，专科方向加分
abstract: Pathology reporting requires translating tissue observations across regions and slides into specific diagnoses and supporting morphological descriptions. However, the use of explicit tissue-composition measurements to guide H&E-based report generation remains underexplored. Thus, we developed PathXAI, which combines segmentation-derived tissue information with H&E images and optional domain knowledge to guide diagnostic reasoning, targeted reinspection and structured report writing. Its segmentation component exceeded baselines in mean Dice on internal and external tests. In automated report evaluation on 1,200 public and 151 private cases, PathXAI achieved higher agreement with reference diagnoses and documented morphology than the H&E-based comparators. On the public evaluation cohort, PathXAI-Report exceeded Qwen + H&E in cancer family match rate by 4.4 percentage points and in finding F1 by 5.7 percentage points. PathXAI generates evidence-linked reports with a self-hosted pretrained vision-language model, without updating its weights.

abstract: Evaluation of 3D medical foundation models is typically dominated by downstream task scores, which entangle representation quality with adaptation choices. This is especially critical in volumetric imaging, where spacing and anisotropy can substantially alter image statistics while the anatomy itself remains unchanged. We therefore introduce \textbf{REFORM-3D}, a \textbf{R}epresentation-centric \textbf{E}valuation \textbf{F}ramew\textbf{OR}k for benchmarking frozen 3D medical vision foundation \textbf{M}odels across three questions: Acquisition Robustness, asking whether features remain stable when spacing varies while anatomy is fixed; Cross-Modal Anatomical Alignment, asking whether labeled anatomical structures remain recoverable across modalities under balanced bidirectional retrieval; and Anatomical Transfer, asking whether organ identity remains recoverable from limited labeled support under case-disjoint evaluation. These are also pretraining questions, because what a 3D encoder learns depends on how volumes are geometrically presented during self-supervised pretraining. We further introduce Med3DINO encoder family, pretrained on $62.6$K unlabeled MR, CT, PET, CTA, and CBCT volumes under three explicit geometric assumptions: isotropic normalization, voxel-relative sampling, and spacing-aware resampling. Across Med3DINO and heterogeneous external encoders, REFORM-3D reveals module-specific strengths rather than a single model ordering. Within the controlled Med3DINO comparison, voxel-relative sampling yields lower embedding drift, whereas spacing-aware resampling favors anatomical transfer; semantic-transfer advantages depend on the dataset and feature type. abstract: [Medical physics] Accurate and comprehensive segmentation of pulmonary vasculature is essential for diagnosing various pulmonary diseases and lung surgical planning. To develop a deep learning model for pulmonary vessels segmentation based on both computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) and non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) data, and to evaluate its performance on a clinical dataset. In this retrospective study, we collected 427 cases of chest CT data from different countries and manufacturers, including 213 CTPA cases and 214 NCCT cases. And we designed a CTPA and NCCT ground truth (GT) generation method producing high-accuracy vessel annotation dataset. Then we developed a 3D U-Net based deep learning method with the Vessel Lumen Structure Optimization Module (VLSOM). We numerically evaluated model using metrics including Centerline Recall (Cl-Recall), Centerline DICE (Cl-DICE), Average Symmetric Surface Distance (ASSD) and 95% Hausdorff Distance (HD95) focusing on the integrity of vascular structures. Finally, the model performance was visually assessed in an independent external dataset. In the numerical evaluation on the internal test dataset with 57 cases, our model achieved Cl-DICE, Cl-Recall and HD95 values of 0.909 (95% CI [0.904, 0.914]), 0.883 (95% CI [0.873, 0.891]) and 1.861 mm (95% CI [1.674 mm, 2.073 mm]) which is superior to the state of the art (SOTA) baseline model nnU-Net v2 of 0.860 (95% CI [0.852, 0.867]), 0.772 (95% CI [0.760, 0.783])and 2.458 mm (95% CI [2.219 mm, 2.708 mm]) (all p < 0.001). abstract: [JMIR bioinformatics and biotechnology] The assessment of the risk of bias (RoB) of each study is a necessary but labor-intensive step in conducting a systematic review (SR). There is a potential for AI to reduce the time and effort needed for RoB assessment and improve consistency between reviewers, but little is known about the accuracy of AI-based RoB assessments. In this study, we aim to evaluate the performance of a large language model (LLM) when given the questions from the RoB tool and the relevant passages from the full-text papers in assessing RoB in observational studies of environmental exposures and health outcomes. We evaluated the performance of GPT-5-mini on 128 observational studies from a SR of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances and health outcomes conducted by the National Academies of Sciences. The navigation guide (NavGuide), a domain-based RoB tool designed for environmental studies, was used. For each paper-domain pair, the LLM was provided with the questions and guidance from the NavGuide and the human-identified text passages addressing that domain. The LLM returned a structured RoB rating, which was compared to the human-adjudicated ratings to quantify agreement and identify patterns of discrepancy. GPT-5-mini RoB assessments for exact matches (64.5%; κ=0.199, Gwet AC2=0.882, F1-score=0.311) remained lower than the concordance between humans and the reference standard (87.5%-91.4%). Performance improved substantially for partial matches, reflecting agreement in direction but not necessarily in magnitude (eg, "low" and "probably low"), with percent concordance of 91.9% (κ=0.241, Gwet AC2=0.910, F1-score=0.614; for humans, 97.9%-98.6% concordance). Performance varied across the NavGuide domains, with the worst performance in domain 1 (selection bias) and the best in domain 4 (outcome assessment). The models tended to be more stringent than humans, often assigning higher RoB ratings (eg, "probably low" when humans assigned "low"). Our results suggest that although concordance was moderate and inconsistent across domains, LLMs may be sufficiently accurate for use with human oversight. LLMs can flag cases for human adjudication or consistency checking but are not ready for use as an independent second reviewer without human oversight.

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Clinical large language model agents depend on both model capability and the surrounding system that selects information, constrains actions, and verifies execution. In this Viewpoint, we argue that this harness should be an explicit unit of clinical agent design, evaluation, and reporting. Our aim is to help clinical informatics and development teams specify this layer and to help evaluators and institutional governance teams assess its contributions and risks. Selected benchmarks show substantial performance differences across harness configurations, but architecture comparisons, bundled improvements, and within-model component comparisons support different levels of causal attribution. We propose a revisable 3-tier framework: tier 1 specifies general orchestration functions, including prompts, tools, output schemas, control flow, memory, and generic verification; tier 2 specifies their clinical adaptations for knowledge integration, differential reasoning, missingness and temporality, safety verification, and workflow alignment; and tier 3 specifies a failure-driven evaluation cycle applied to both. Our contribution is a framework that makes these connections explicit. We provide classification rules, an illustrative clinical example, a proposed evaluation protocol, and a minimum reporting checklist. Observable execution traces are distinguished from private model reasoning, with provenance and privacy safeguards supporting retrospective reconstruction. Evaluation should separate task success, clinical correctness, process safety, and operational reliability. Lightweight fine-tuning can complement harness design; their interaction requires controlled study. The framework is a proposal for empirical testing, not a validated taxonomy or evidence of deployment safety.

abstract: [Ultrasonic imaging] This study introduces MSF-US, a novel deep learning framework integrating multi-scale feature fusion and attention mechanisms. It aims to enhance early breast cancer detection and improve diagnostic accuracy in ultrasound images, particularly addressing the challenges of capturing global and local features in dense breast tissue. The MSF-US model combines hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction with attention mechanisms to selectively focus on diagnostically relevant regions. The framework was rigorously validated on a multi-center dataset of breast ultrasound images. Its performance was compared against state-of-the-art models, such as ResNet-50, Vision Transformer (ViT), and Swin Transformer, evaluating accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and area under the curve (AUC). In 5-fold cross-validation, MSF-US yielded an average accuracy of 0.9057, sensitivity of 0.9075, and AUC of 0.9212 with high net clinical benefit. On the independent C3 test set, it surpassed 8 SOTA baselines with a peak accuracy of 0.9406, F1 score of 0.9483, and AUC of 0.9391. Evaluation on 3 diverse public cohorts (BUSI, BUS-BRA, and BrEaST) confirmed excellent cross-center generalizability, achieving AUCs up to 0.9519. Ablation analysis validated that the synergy of multi-scale feature fusion and attention mechanisms significantly boosted diagnostic precision over single-scale baselines. MSF-US delivers state-of-the-art performance in breast ultrasound imaging, offering a highly reliable tool for early breast cancer detection. Its innovative design successfully addresses the limitations of existing methods, presenting significant clinical potential to improve diagnostic accuracy and patient outcomes.

abstract: [Progress in retinal and eye research] Slit-lamp colour photography remains a cornerstone of anterior segment documentation and longitudinal monitoring. However, conventional slit-lamp photography has seen relatively limited technological advancement compared with the rapid development of quantitative anterior-segment modalities such as AS-OCT, Scheimpflug tomography and confocal microscopy. Despite the wide diffusion of digital cameras, smartphones, and high-end slit-lamp systems, ocular surface photography (OSP) remains hampered by the absence of standardised acquisition and processing protocols. The convex, aspheric geometry of the ocular surface, off-axis illumination, peripheral defocus, automatic colour correction, and pupil-driven exposure variation in retroillumination limit reproducibility, inter-device comparability, and clinical utility. In this review we critically appraise current OSP applications across major ocular surface conditions (dry eye disease, conjunctival hyperaemia, infectious keratitis, ocular surface burns, and ocular surface neoplasia), mapping the hardware, software, and reproducibility limitations that constrain clinical practice. We then examine how these limitations propagate into artificial intelligence (AI) development, where the absence of large, well-annotated, demographically diverse OSP datasets, together with the lack of reproducible quantitative phenotypes and reliable labels, is now the principal bottleneck to clinically deployable models; we discuss patient-level data partitioning and external validation, and outline how deep learning, federated learning and foundation models can both utilise and improve OSP. Finally, we propose a minimum acquisition and dataset specification, tiered by clinical setting from research to community screening, and a staged roadmap that combines hardware standardisation (focus-stacked, illumination-controlled, colour-calibrated acquisition), interoperable metadata-rich storage (DICOM where infrastructure permits), quantitative phenotype definition, and diverse international dataset collaborations, so that the ocular surface can benefit from quantitative imaging and AI as other areas of ophthalmology have begun to.
zh_abstract: [Progress in retinal and eye research] 裂隙灯彩色照相仍是眼前节记录和纵向监测的基石。然而，与AS-OCT、Scheimpflug断层成像和共聚焦显微镜等定量眼前节检查方式的快速发展相比，传统裂隙灯摄影的技术进步相对有限。尽管数码相机、智能手机和高端裂隙灯系统广泛普及，眼表摄影（OSP）仍因缺乏标准化的采集和处理方案而受到限制。眼表的凸形非球面几何结构、离轴照明、周边离焦、自动色彩校正，以及后照法中由瞳孔驱动的曝光变化，限制了其可重复性、不同设备间的可比性和临床实用性。在本综述中，我们批判性地评价了OSP在主要眼表疾病（干眼病、结膜充血、感染性角膜炎、眼表烧伤和眼表肿瘤）中的当前应用，梳理了制约临床实践的硬件、软件和可重复性方面的局限。随后我们探讨了这些局限如何传导至人工智能（AI）的开发：缺乏大规模、标注良好、人口学多样的OSP数据集，以及缺乏可重复的定量表型和可靠标签，是目前可临床部署模型的主要瓶颈；我们讨论了患者层面的数据划分和外部验证，并概述了深度学习、联邦学习和基础模型如何既能利用又能改进OSP。最后，我们提出了按从研究到社区筛查的临床场景分层的最低采集和数据集规范，以及一个分阶段路线图，该路线图结合了硬件标准化（焦点堆叠、照明可控、色彩校准的采集）、可互操作且元数据丰富的存储（在基础设施允许时采用DICOM）、定量表型定义，以及多样化的国际数据集合作，使眼表能够像眼科其他领域一样受益于定量成像和AI。

abstract: Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. We further introduce BILBY-MD, a reference-based all-atom molecular dynamics evaluation framework. Applied to statically solved designs from the original MotifBench benchmark, it compares motif drift, scaffold drift, motif-contact preservation, and motif-dihedral free-energy landscapes against reference simulations. Of 55 statically solved model-problem pairs, 31 satisfy our MD-supported criterion and only 8 pass all checks. Compact, self-contained motifs are often MD-supported, whereas interface-like or context-dependent motifs fail more frequently. Static refolding success therefore provides useful evidence of local motif recovery but does not establish dynamical fidelity of the full scaffold. BILBY highlights three complementary axes of motif-scaffolding evaluation: target coverage, unique-solution yield, and MD-supported dynamical fidelity.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质基序支架（motif scaffolding）基准用于评估生成模型能否围绕功能上重要的残基构建支架。其结论取决于所测试的基序以及定义成功的标准。现有基准通常使用小规模、人工筛选的基序集和静态重折叠标准，但蛋白质功能往往取决于构象系综及其转变。在此，我们同时解决基准范围和成功标准两方面的问题。我们提出了BILBY-PRO，这是一个由系统方法得到的、来自与PROSITE关联的实验结构的结构保守功能基序基准，包含来自174个PROSITE基序模式条目的220个案例。对六个近期支架生成模型的评估显示，它们在目标覆盖率和独特解产出方面呈现出不同模式：RFDiffusion和Proteina解决的目标更多，而ESM3在其所解决的目标上产生更多独特的成功支架。我们进一步提出了BILBY-MD，一种基于参照的全原子分子动力学评估框架。将其应用于原始MotifBench基准中静态求解成功的设计时，它将基序漂移、支架漂移、基序接触保留以及基序二面角自由能景观与参照模拟进行比较。在55个静态求解成功的模型-问题配对中，31个满足我们的MD支持标准，仅8个通过全部检查。紧凑、自包含的基序通常得到MD支持，而界面样或依赖上下文的基序失败更为频繁。因此，静态重折叠成功为局部基序恢复提供了有用证据，但并不能确立完整支架的动力学保真度。BILBY突出了基序支架评估的三个互补维度：目标覆盖率、独特解产出以及MD支持的动力学保真度。

abstract: [European heart journal. Digital health] Evidence-based medicine represents the systematic approach through which physicians today use the best available scientific evidence from clinical research to guide their clinical decision-making process. However, the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI), with its diverse models and potential applications in medicine, is leading to a new form of research driven by 'big data' and heterogeneous datasets, extending beyond conventional statistical analysis and thereby making AI literacy an increasingly essential competence for clinicians. Artificial intelligence applications in cardiology have shown potential to support disease diagnosis, risk prediction, workflow efficiency, and therapeutic decision-making. However, despite these opportunities, AI may also represent a technological barrier for many physicians, due to its mathematical foundations and the speed at which models evolve. A solid understanding of AI concepts is therefore necessary for cardiologists to critically interpret results and engage with this new research landscape. This scientific statement explores AI in cardiology from an educational perspective, outlining the key knowledge required to build adequate AI literacy. The goal is to enable cardiologists not only to avoid reliance on external experts for methodological decisions, but also to collaborate with greater insight and informed judgment.

Digital health] 循证医学是指医生如今借以运用临床研究中可获得的最佳科学证据来指导临床决策过程的系统方法。然而，人工智能（AI）及其多样化的模型和在医学中的潜在应用的出现，正在催生一种由“大数据”和异质性数据集驱动的新型研究形式，其范围超出了传统统计分析，从而使 AI 素养日益成为临床医生的一项必备能力。人工智能在心脏病学中的应用已显示出支持疾病诊断、风险预测、提高工作流程效率和治疗决策的潜力。然而，尽管存在这些机遇，由于其数学基础以及模型更新的速度，AI 对许多医生而言也可能构成一道技术壁垒。因此，心脏病学家需要扎实理解 AI 概念，以便批判性地解读结果并参与这一新的研究领域。本科学声明从教育的角度探讨心脏病学中的 AI，概述建立足够 AI 素养所需的关键知识。其目标是使心脏病学家不仅无需在方法学决策上依赖外部专家，而且能够以更深入的洞察力和明智的判断力开展合作。

abstract: [Australian dental journal] Digital scribes are increasingly being adopted in healthcare to reduce documentation burden and improve clinical workflow. These systems generate clinical records from clinician-patient conversations using speech recognition and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies. While studies in medicine suggest benefits including reduced administrative workload and improved clinician experience, evidence in dentistry remains limited. This narrative review examines the current evidence, challenges, and implementation considerations associated with digital scribes in Australian dental practice. Potential benefits include improved workflow efficiency, documentation support, clinician satisfaction and enhanced practitioner-patient relationships. Reported limitations include omissions, factual inaccuracies, poor recognition of dental terminology, reduced performance in complex communication environments and the generation of misleading or excessive clinical records. Potential unintended consequences include automation bias, changes in clinician-patient interactions, impacts on clinical reasoning, patient self-censorship, and equity concerns related to algorithmic bias. Dental practitioners remain professionally accountable for the accuracy and completeness of AI-generated clinical records. Consequently, implementation of digital scribes in dental settings requires robust governance, informed consent processes, clinician oversight and ongoing performance auditing. Further research is needed to evaluate the impact of digital scribes in dental practice, including their effects on patient outcomes, dental education and health equity.
zh_abstract: [澳大利亚牙科杂志] 数字抄录员（digital scribes）在医疗领域的应用日益增多，旨在减轻文书记录负担并改善临床工作流程。这类系统利用语音识别和人工智能（AI）技术，根据临床医生与患者之间的对话生成临床记录。医学领域的研究提示其益处包括减少行政工作量和改善临床医生体验，但牙科领域的证据仍然有限。本叙述性综述探讨了数字抄录员在澳大利亚牙科实践中的现有证据、挑战及实施方面的考虑。潜在益处包括提高工作流程效率、辅助文书记录、提高临床医生满意度以及改善医患关系。已报告的局限性包括遗漏、事实性错误、对牙科术语识别不佳、在复杂沟通环境中表现下降，以及生成具有误导性或过多的临床记录。潜在的非预期后果包括自动化偏倚、临床医生与患者互动的改变、对临床推理的影响、患者自我审查，以及与算法偏倚相关的公平性问题。牙科从业者仍需对 AI 生成的临床记录的准确性和完整性承担专业责任。因此，在牙科场所实施数字抄录员需要健全的治理、知情同意流程、临床医生监督以及持续的性能审核。仍需进一步研究以评估数字抄录员在牙科实践中的影响，包括其对患者结局、牙科教育和健康公平的作用。

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Misdiagnoses in emergency departments are often associated with the difficulty in interpreting radiological findings on bone fractures due to millimetric fractures, overlapping bones, or superimpositions. Despite the high efficiency of state-of-the-art models in diagnosing such cases, their massive computational requirements severely hinder their implementation on resource-constrained devices in real-world clinical settings. In this study, we propose an ultralightweight CNN-ViT model, CrossBoneNet, which is designed for edge AI compatibility with minimal memory requirements. CrossBoneNet combines local microfracture detection using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and global anatomical recognition using vision transformers (ViTs). The model merges features from both architectures using the proposed asymmetric reversed cross-attention, where CNN features act as queries and ViT features act as keys and values-to efficiently map fine-grained local anomalies into a broader global anatomical context. Operating with a minimal parameter count (0.593 M) and low computational cost (1.527 GFLOPs), CrossBoneNet achieved a PR-AUC of 0.8498 ± 0.0086 and a ROC-AUC of 0.8427 ± 0.0072 on the MURA dataset in a patient-wise isolated evaluation. It achieves highly competitive performance-remaining within a 4% margin of the 88.59 million parameter ConvNeXt-Base model-while delivering over 99% memory savings. After fine-tuning on the FracAtlas dataset, CrossBoneNet achieved a specificity of 0.9760 ± 0.0080 and PR-AUC of 0.7568 ± 0.0414, demonstrating effective cross-domain transfer learning. With a compact footprint (< 3 MB) and high specificity at the default 0.50 operating threshold, CrossBoneNet demonstrates potential as a point-of-care decision support and worklist prioritization tool on resource-constrained devices, while calibrating the decision threshold (e.g., τ = 0.3837 and τ = 0.3449 ) enables high-sensitivity screening modes (achieving 85.03% and 89.96% sensitivity on MURA, respectively), pending prospective validation. This retrospective study establishes proof of concept; future work will focus on prospective clinical trials and expansion to multiclass fracture classification.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 急诊科的误诊常与骨折影像学表现解读困难相关，原因包括毫米级骨折、骨骼重叠或叠加影像。尽管最先进的模型在诊断此类病例方面效率很高，但其庞大的计算需求严重阻碍了它们在真实临床环境中资源受限设备上的部署。在本研究中，我们提出了一种超轻量级CNN-ViT模型CrossBoneNet，其设计兼容边缘AI，内存需求极低。CrossBoneNet结合了利用卷积神经网络（CNN）的局部微骨折检测和利用视觉Transformer（ViT）的全局解剖识别。该模型通过所提出的非对称反向交叉注意力融合两种架构的特征，其中CNN特征作为查询（queries），ViT特征作为键和值（keys and values），从而有效地将细粒度的局部异常映射到更广泛的全局解剖背景中。CrossBoneNet参数量极少（0.593 M），计算成本低（1.527 GFLOPs），在MURA数据集上按患者隔离评估时，PR-AUC为0.8498 ± 0.0086，ROC-AUC为0.8427 ± 0.0072。其性能极具竞争力——与8859万参数的ConvNeXt-Base模型相差不超过4%——同时节省了超过99%的内存。在FracAtlas数据集上微调后，CrossBoneNet的特异度为0.9760 ± 0.0080，PR-AUC为0.7568 ± 0.0414，显示出有效的跨域迁移学习能力。CrossBoneNet体积小巧（< 3 MB），在默认0.50操作阈值下具有较高的特异度，显示出作为资源受限设备上的床旁决策支持和工作列表优先级排序工具的潜力；同时，校准决策阈值（例如τ = 0.3837和τ = 0.3449）可实现高灵敏度筛查模式（在MURA上分别达到85.03%和89.96%的灵敏度），有待前瞻性验证。这项回顾性研究确立了概念验证；未来工作将聚焦于前瞻性临床试验以及扩展至多类别骨折分类。

abstract: [Journal of biophotonics] HER2 assessment in breast cancer relies on immunohistochemistry (IHC) with reflex in situ hybridization for equivocal cases, while conventional bright-field imaging provides limited quantitative optical information. We investigated microscopic hyperspectral imaging (HSI) of HER2-stained sections for slide-level molecular status prediction. HSI data from 43 cases (21 HER2-positive, 22 HER2-negative; 400-1000 nm, 128 bands) were acquired between January 2024 and August 2025. After calibration, optical-density conversion, tissue masking, and Savitzky-Golay smoothing, we developed SpectralMix-MIL, a weakly supervised multiple-instance learning model combining learnable spectral projection (K = 32) with attention pooling. On a patient-level 7:3 train/test split, SpectralMix-MIL achieved an AUROC of 0.923 and AUPRC of 0.910. Repeated stratified fivefold cross-validation yielded mean AUROC 0.904 ± 0.041 and AUPRC 0.892 ± 0.045, while leave-one-out cross-validation yielded AUROC 0.897. These findings support microscopic HSI for quantitative breast cancer molecular phenotyping, pending larger external validation.
