abstract: [Gerontology & geriatrics education] As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly embedded in higher education, gerontology educators face new opportunities and ethical challenges when integrating AI tools into teaching, mentorship, and professional practice. Rapid advances in AI, alongside evolving aging research and policy, require educators to adapt their pedagogical approaches. Organizers for the Academy for Gerontology in Higher Education's 14th Annual Teaching Institute sought to address this need by providing instructor-focused professional development on emerging issues of AI in gerontology education, with an emphasis on ethical, inclusive, and discipline-specific applications. In this paper, we describe the rationale, structure, and content of the 14th Annual Teaching Institute and examine its impact on instructor confidence and perceived competence with utilizing AI professionally. A mixed methods evaluation of the workshop included pre- and post-surveys, confidence ratings, and qualitative feedback from attendees (N = 21). Quantitative results demonstrated statistically significant increases in confidence and perceived competence using AI across multiple professional domains. Qualitative findings highlighted the value of peer learning, hands-on activities, and contextualized discussions of AI in gerontology education. Findings suggest that structured, interactive professional development can enhance instructors' capacity to engage critically and responsibly with AI while reinforcing core gerontology competencies.
zh_abstract: [老年学与老年医学教育] 随着人工智能（AI）日益融入高等教育，老年学教育者在将AI工具整合到教学、指导和专业实践中时，面临新的机遇和伦理挑战。AI的快速发展，加之老龄化研究和政策的不断演变，要求教育者调整其教学方法。高等教育老年学学会（Academy for Gerontology in Higher Education）第14届年度教学研修班的组织者试图应对这一需求，针对老年学教育中AI的新兴问题提供以教师为中心的专业发展培训，重点关注符合伦理、具有包容性且针对具体学科的应用。本文介绍了第14届年度教学研修班的理念、结构和内容，并考察其对教师在专业上使用AI的信心和自觉能力的影响。对该工作坊采用混合方法评估，包括前后调查、信心评分以及参与者（N = 21）的定性反馈。定量结果显示，在多个专业领域中，使用AI的信心和自觉能力均出现具有统计学意义的提高。定性结果突出了同伴学习、动手活动以及结合情境讨论老年学教育中AI的价值。研究结果表明，结构化的互动式专业发展可以增强教师批判性且负责任地运用AI的能力，同时强化老年学的核心能力。

title: Exploring clinician attitudes towards artificial intelligence-generated discharge summaries.
zh_title: 临床医生对AI生成出院小结的态度探索
summary: 对5名临床医生开展混合方法研究，考察其对AI出院小结的态度与编辑行为。
key_points: 5名医生审阅3份AI生成小结
医生普遍认为可节省时间
多数编辑为结构语气优化而非事实纠错
reason: 仅5名临床医生的探索性研究，样本极小，属增量档
abstract: [Internal medicine journal] We conducted an exploratory mixed-methods study of clinician attitudes and editing behaviours towards artificial intelligence (AI)-generated discharge summaries. Five clinicians reviewed three summaries and indicated what changes they would make and why, answered a questionnaire, engaged in semi-structured interviews and viewed screen mock-ups of additional editing features. All clinicians expressed positive sentiments and saw AI as saving time. Edits were driven by professional pride and etiquette, most of which were not corrections of factual errors but optimisation of structure, coherence, conciseness, reasoning and tone. Tension arose between desire for personalised content versus potential benefits of standardisation. Various novel editing features were seen as expediting summary review.

title: Learning through Capacity Awareness to Minimize Hospital Readmissions
zh_title: 容量感知学习以降低医院再入院
summary: 在出院决策的排队马尔可夫决策过程中引入周期性重训练的再入院风险预测，分析容量感知策略如何缓解删失偏倚。
key_points: 指出出院决策造成的删失偏倚与恶性循环
容量感知策略使住院时长多样化
无需显式公平约束即可一致估计风险
reason: 理论性预印本，临床验证有限，属增量档
abstract: Predictive algorithms are increasingly used to guide hospital discharge decisions, yet these models can exhibit censoring bias for vulnerable patients due to insufficient historical data or past discharge decisions. When biased readmission risk predictors are used to inform discharges, the training data generated by discharge decisions may perpetuate similar biases when predictors are re-trained, leading to a vicious cycle. We extend a queueing-based Markov decision process for hospital discharge to incorporate periodically retrained readmission risk predictors. Our key insight is that cost-optimal, "capacity-aware" operational decision policies can naturally diversify the lengths of stay at which patient outcomes are observed, enabling consistent estimation of readmission risk without explicit fairness constraints. We prove that repeated retraining under discharge-up-to policies converges to unbiased risk estimates under well-specification. In synthetic experiments and calibrated simulations based on patient-level data from a partner hospital, we find that where commonly used threshold-on-risk policies can remain persistently biased, discharge-up-to policies reduce learning error over status quo decision policies (such as thresholding on risk) by 24%-25%. These improvements to estimation also mitigate some forms of bias, reducing readmission cost disparities (adjusted for baseline risk differences between demographic groups) by 38%-63%. Our results demonstrate how capacity-aware decision policies can improve both predictive performance and fairness by addressing censoring bias.

title: One-Shot Hierarchical Federated Clustering for Distributed Non-IID Biomedical Data Analysis
zh_title: 面向分布式非独立同分布生物医学数据的一次性层次联邦聚类
summary: 提出一次性层次联邦聚类框架，仅通过客户端到服务器的原型级单向通信完成跨机构数据分析。
key_points: 客户端探索分布，服务器聚合
单向原型通信降低计算与隐私风险
针对非IID与嵌套结构数据
reason: 联邦聚类方法预印本，摘要未见实证细节，属增量档
abstract: In multi-institutional biomedical data analysis, comprehensive disease profiles are often fragmented across different data silos. Furthermore, local data distributions typically exhibit varying levels of granularity or even complex nested structures. Although Hierarchical Clustering (HC) is a powerful tool for exploring such data topologies, its cumbersome recursive process incurs prohibitive computational overhead and renders it highly susceptible to privacy leakage. This paper, therefore, introduces an efficient one-shot hierarchical FC framework that performs client-end (institutions) distribution exploration and server-end distribution aggregation through one-way prototype-level communication from clients to the server. Although the designed one-shot prototype transmission guarantees minimal computational overhead and mitigates privacy risks, it inevitably incurs information loss. To counteract this, a multi-granular competitive learning mechanism is proposed on the server to fuse the clusterlets, effectively maximizing the retention and mining of global distribution topologies under limited, one-way communication constraints. It turns out that the complex cluster distributions across clients can be efficiently explored, and extensive experiments comparing state-of-the-art methods on public datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework in balancing robust clustering, privacy preservation, and computational efficiency.

title: DuSS-PET: Self-Supervised Low-Dose PET Reconstruction Using Pseudo-Dual-Domain Consistency Without Paired Data
zh_title: DuSS-PET：无配对数据的自监督低剂量PET重建
summary: 提出基于 Noisier2Noise 与伪双域一致性的自监督低剂量 PET 重建框架，无需配对低/全剂量扫描。
key_points: Bernoulli 扰动模拟低计数噪声
在伪正弦图域使用自适应 Swin Transformer
无需配对数据以缓解临床获取难题
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Positron emission tomography (PET) is pivotal in medicine and healthcare, but requires high radiation doses for quality imaging. Although deep learning has shown promise for low-dose PET reconstruction/enhancement, existing methods primarily rely on fully supervised learning, which requires paired low- and full-dose scans that are clinically impractical to obtain. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose DuSS-PET, a novel self-supervised PET reconstruction framework that operates without any paired low- and full-dose data. Our method is built upon a computational Noisier2Noise (Nr2N) paradigm, featuring a Bernoulli corruption strategy that serves as an image-space approximation to emulate low-count noise patterns in image-derived pseudo-sinogram representations. The DuSS-PET framework integrates three core components: an adaptive Swin transformer for pseudo-sinogram restoration, a plug-and-play module for image enhancement, and a consistency-constrained SSL strategy that enforces agreement between the pseudo-sinogram and image representations. Extensive experiments on multi-center datasets demonstrate that DuSS-PET achieves superior reconstruction performance, outperforming state-of-the-art SSL methods and achieving comparable or even better results than fully supervised approaches across various dose levels. In particular, it exhibits exceptional generalization across different scanner vendors. This work is among the first self-supervised low-dose PET reconstruction framework that enforces consistency between reconstructed images and pseudo-sinograms, where the pseudo-sinogram generated in the image space serves as a solid computational consistency constraint for enhanced imaging without full-dose training scans. The source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/ladderlab-xjtu/DuSS-PET.

title: GARP: Real-Time Generative Agents on Local Hardware in a Game Engine
zh_title: GARP：游戏引擎中本地运行的实时生成式智能体
summary: 提出在 Godot 中基于 3B 开源模型、完全本地运行的生成式智能体平台，含情绪、人格、需求与关系系统。
key_points: 全流程本地运行，无需云服务
加入情绪、大五人格、需求与关系系统
将50+候选动作缩至3-8个并用JSON约束输出
reason: 智能体模拟类预印本，工程性强、无医疗验证，属增量档
abstract: Generative agents are game characters whose plans, conversations, and memories are written on the fly by a large language model (LLM). The original Generative Agents demonstration used cloud inference in a custom simulation. We present GARP, a platform for real-time generative agents inside Godot, and describe the Character Behavior System used in GARP 2. The complete loop runs on local hardware using a 3B-parameter open-weight model and no cloud service. Alongside the original planning, memory, and reflection, GARP gives each agent an emotion system driven by LLM appraisal, four graded personality axes drawn from the Big Five that set simulation parameters as well as prompt text, six needs whose urgency grows over time, and pairwise relationships updated after every conversation. The system narrows 50+ candidate actions to typically 3-8, constrains model responses with JSON schemas, and surfaces important memories in decision prompts. A layered optimization strategy (an adjustable game clock, decisions taken ahead of need, multi-tier caching, prompt compression, and fully asynchronous execution) keeps the game responsive while the model thinks. In a nine-scenario evaluation, 25 of 27 runs passed log-based checks. Both failures occurred in the birthday party scenario, where one guest omitted the event from their daily plan.
zh_abstract: 生成式智能体（generative agents）是指其计划、对话和记忆由大语言模型（LLM）即时生成的游戏角色。最初的 Generative Agents 演示在自定义模拟环境中使用云端推理。我们提出了 GARP——一个在 Godot 中运行的实时生成式智能体平台，并介绍 GARP 2 中使用的角色行为系统（Character Behavior System）。完整的运行循环使用一个 3B 参数的开放权重模型在本地硬件上运行，不依赖任何云服务。除原有的规划、记忆和反思之外，GARP 还为每个智能体配备：由 LLM 评估（appraisal）驱动的情绪系统；取自大五人格（Big Five）的四个分级人格维度，这些维度既决定模拟参数，也决定提示词文本；六种紧迫程度随时间增长的需求；以及在每次对话后更新的两两关系。该系统将 50 余个候选动作通常缩减至 3–8 个，使用 JSON 模式（schema）约束模型响应，并在决策提示词中呈现重要记忆。一套分层优化策略（可调节的游戏时钟、提前于需求的决策、多级缓存、提示词压缩以及完全异步执行）使游戏在模型思考期间保持响应。在包含九个场景的评估中，27 次运行里有 25 次通过了基于日志的检查。两次失败均发生在生日派对场景中，其中一位宾客在其每日计划中遗漏了该活动。

title: Complementarity without ground truth?
zh_title: 无真值情形下的人机互补性
summary: 探讨人机互补性对真值的依赖，并将其扩展到以实践目标适当性而非预测为参照的人机交互，如医疗治疗推荐。
key_points: 讨论互补性评估对真值的依赖
非预测任务也可构造适当性标签
涉及医疗AI治疗推荐等场景
reason: 偏理论框架，人机协作评估相关但缺乏实证，属增量档
abstract: Human-AI complementarity captures the idea that a human assisted by an AI system can outperform both the human and the AI acting alone. In prediction tasks, this improvement is assessed against ground truth labels produced through a reference construction procedure and intended to represent the state of affairs to be predicted. Many human-AI interactions, including those where medical AI provides treatment recommendations, however, concern tasks other than predicting what obtains. Their relevant output concerns adequacy relative to a practical goal and depends on several evaluative dimensions. In this work, we examine the ground truth dependence of complementarity and extend it to human-AI interactions where ground truth is not the appropriate reference. We show that tasks beyond prediction can still admit a reference construction procedure that generates adequacy labels. We develop a route for extending complementarity to such settings. It replaces ground truth labels with context-dependent adequacy labels generated through a two-step scoring methodology inspired by multi-criteria decision analysis frameworks in healthcare and it makes the normative choices underlying reference construction explicit. Because the construction of adequacy labels embeds evaluative choices, we draw methodological inspiration from computational reliabilism to identify technical, scientific, and social factors relevant to supporting their construction. Our approach expands the empirical study of human-AI complementarity beyond prediction tasks, enabling its quantitative evaluation in decision-support settings where ground truth is not the appropriate evaluative reference.

title: Deterministic Narrative Gravity: Bridging Theory of Mind and Historical Simulation through ABM-LLM Architectures
zh_title: 确定性叙事引力：ABM-LLM架构下的历史模拟
summary: 提出确定性多智能体框架，将LLM与基于心智理论的智能体建模结合，用SHA-256哈希验证本地固定环境下历史社会模拟的可复现性。
key_points: 针对LLM随机性导致的历史模拟不可复现
本地温度为零运行，并以SHA-256验证产物一致
评估了七种模型配置
reason: 智能体社会模拟，关注可复现性，但信息有限
abstract: Historical social simulation faces a fundamental reproducibility challenge: the stochastic nature of large language models (LLMs) introduces a digital butterfly effect that prevents exact replication across multi-turn runs. Furthermore, the inability to control low-level server parameters in commercial LLM hosting environments severely limits reproducibility. To overcome this opacity, we present a deterministic multi-agent framework coupling LLMs to an Agent-Based Modelling (ABM) pipeline grounded in Theory of Mind (ToM) and Cognitive Archaeology, and validate exact artifact identity within local, pinned execution environments using SHA-256 hashing. Run locally at temperature zero with clean per-call model reloads, the system injects differentiated cognitive states per turn through dissonance-driven behavioural modes and gated internal voices. Evaluating seven model configurations spanning 4B to 31B parameters against an ablated baseline reveals clear operational boundaries. Small models ($\leq$8B) suffer from context capacity overload, producing repetitive, specular dialogue loops. However, at $\geq$12B parameters, the ABM scaffolding breaks the monotonous response patterns seen in ablation. Crucially, these scaffolded models exhibit spontaneous diegetic expansion: they coherently expand scenario lore through tactically motivated, anachronism-free details rather than escalating into aggression. By resisting the structural pull toward premature scene closure, scaffolded sessions sustain an open terminal Narrative Vector ($V_N = \mathrm{Open}$ in 12/21 overall; 9/9 in official $\geq$12B configurations) whereas unscaffolded ablation never does (0/21). This framework provides a transparent, auditable benchmark architecture for virtual archaeology, with the full pipeline released as open-source software to enable independent replication.

title: Causal Outcome Learning with Noisy Proxies
zh_title: 含噪代理变量的因果结局学习（SCOUT）
summary: 提出SCOUT框架，在高维含噪基线变量下学习可解释、对治疗有响应的结局，并估计ATE与CATE。
key_points: 在学习过程中全程调整混杂
构建至多二维的调整表示
可用于观察性生物医学数据的异质性分析
reason: 因果方法预印本，摘要未见外部验证或临床结局
abstract: Modern observational biomedical datasets contain increasingly extensive baseline and outcome measurements, yet detecting a clinically meaningful treatment effect remains difficult because investigators must identify an outcome that captures treatment response while adjusting for confounding distributed across numerous noisy baseline variables. We introduce SCOUT (Score-based Causal Outcome Learning Using Treatment signals), a framework that learns a clinically interpretable, treatment-responsive outcome while adjusting for confounding throughout the learning process. SCOUT constructs low-dimensional adjustment representations of high-dimensional baseline measurements to estimate the average treatment effect (ATE) and conditional average treatment effect (CATE) for the learned outcome. Importantly, the final adjustment space is at most two-dimensional, allowing treatment-effect heterogeneity to be estimated in this space rather than in the full high-dimensional covariate space. SCOUT also introduces a fourth-order statistic for testing treatment-effect heterogeneity that emphasizes unusually large deviations from the ATE. In synthetic and semi-synthetic experiments, the algorithm achieved competitive ATE estimation accuracy and substantially lower CATE estimation error. In an observational study of patients with bipolar disorder, SCOUT identified a clinically recognizable lithium-associated adverse-effect profile, detecting both a significant ATE (Holm-adjusted $p$ = 0.0026) and significant treatment-effect heterogeneity (Holm-adjusted $p$ = 0.033).These results demonstrate how jointly learning outcomes and controlling for confounding can facilitate the discovery of treatment effects in high-dimensional observational data.

title: Auto-GlaKG: Automated Biomarker Reasoning for Explainable Glaucoma Detection
zh_title: Auto-GlaKG：用于可解释青光眼检测的自动生物标志物推理
summary: 提出结合ResNet50预测视杯盘比及形态征象与知识图谱规则推理的青光眼检测框架，在689张眼底图上交叉验证AUC为0.951。
key_points: ResNet50预测CDR与六项形态征象
知识图谱聚合规则贡献得到青光眼评分
689张图像五折交叉验证，合并AUC 0.951
reason: 单一小数据集内部交叉验证，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Interpretable glaucoma detection requires a transparent connection between fundus images, clinically meaningful biomarkers, and diagnostic predictions. Knowledge graph (KG) reasoning provides this structure, but performance measured using annotated biomarkers does not establish performance when only images are available. We present Auto-GlaKG, an automated framework that combines image-based biomarker prediction with fixed clinical-prior rules. A ResNet50 network predicts the cup-to-disc ratio (CDR) and six morphological signs using biomarker supervision, and a KG reasoner aggregates their signed rule contributions into a glaucoma score. On 689 fundus images evaluated using stratified, group-aware five-fold cross-validation, Auto-GlaKG achieves a pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.951 (95\% confidence interval: 0.931--0.969), with sensitivity of 0.970 and specificity of 0.779. The matched image classifier also achieves an AUC of 0.951, while the rule stage adds 0.2~ms per image. Replacing predicted CDR with its annotation increases fold-mean AUC from 0.953 to 0.995. The framework provides an explicit rule-level account of image-based predictions and identifies CDR estimation as a priority for validation using independently measured biomarkers.
zh_abstract: 可解释的青光眼检测需要在眼底图像、具有临床意义的生物标志物和诊断预测之间建立透明的联系。知识图谱（KG）推理提供了这种结构，但使用已标注生物标志物所测得的性能，并不能说明仅有图像时的性能。我们提出 Auto-GlaKG，这是一种将基于图像的生物标志物预测与固定的临床先验规则相结合的自动化框架。ResNet50 网络在生物标志物监督下预测杯盘比（CDR）和六种形态学征象，KG 推理器将这些征象带符号的规则贡献汇总为青光眼评分。在 689 张眼底图像上，采用分层、分组感知的五折交叉验证，Auto-GlaKG 的合并受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为 0.951（95% 置信区间：0.931–0.969），敏感度为 0.970，特异度为 0.779。匹配的图像分类器 AUC 同样为 0.951，而规则阶段每张图像仅增加 0.2 ms。用标注的 CDR 替换预测的 CDR 后，各折平均 AUC 由 0.953 升至 0.995。该框架为基于图像的预测提供了明确的规则层面解释，并提示 CDR 估计应作为使用独立测量的生物标志物进行验证的优先事项。

title: Multi-Agent Generative Artificial Intelligence for Transfusion Reaction Feature Extraction
zh_title: 多智能体生成式AI用于输血反应特征提取
summary: 构建开源多智能体流程，用三种开放权重大模型从临床笔记中提取NHSN输血反应特征，并由两名医师盲法评估。
key_points: 整理NHSN协议的181个特征
在50份笔记上评估三种开放权重LLM
来源含专家场景、病例报告和MIMIC-IV
reason: 小样本50份笔记的预印本，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: BACKGROUND: Many transfusion reactions are not reported to hemovigilance systems, and the features needed to recognize them are often documented only in free-text clinical notes. We sought to develop and evaluate an open-source, multi-agent artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline to extract transfusion reaction features defined by the National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) Hemovigilance Module from clinical notes. METHODS: We curated 181 features from the NHSN protocol and developed a multi-stage pipeline that extracted features, their timing, and clinical details from free-text notes. Three open-weight large language models (Qwen 3.6-27B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Kimi K3) were applied to 50 notes from expert-written scenarios, published case reports, and MIMIC-IV discharge summaries. Two physicians independently evaluated every model output in a blinded interface. The primary analysis was restricted to feature occurrences with concordant physician assessments. RESULTS: Physicians agreed on 1,201 of 1,343 co-rated feature occurrences (89.4%; Krippendorff's alpha 0.73). Precision was above 0.98 for all models. Sensitivity was 0.774 (95% CI 0.745-0.800) for Kimi K3, 0.636 (0.604-0.667) for GPT-OSS-120B, and 0.624 (0.593-0.655) for Qwen 3.6-27B, and specificity ranged from 0.952 to 0.991. Omissions accounted for more than 94% of false negatives. Timing and clinical details were judged supported or reasonable in more than 92% and 97% of assessments, respectively. Results were consistent across note sources and in analyses including discordant assessments. CONCLUSION: Multi-agent AI pipelines provide a feasible method for extracting transfusion reaction signals from clinical notes with high precision. Our work may have applications in active hemovigilance, reaction classification, and big data research.

title: AOPTK: Open-Source Software for AI-Assisted Toxicological Literature Analysis
zh_title: AOPTK：AI辅助毒理学文献分析开源软件
summary: 预印本提出开源Python工具包AOPTK，支持文献检索、PDF全文处理及LLM辅助分析，用于毒理学与生物医学文献。

集成LLM辅助分析工具

abstract: Motivation: Toxicologists today face a challenge: although vast amounts of data describing how chemicals affect human health are available across scientific publications and regulatory reports, much of this information remains underutilized because extracting and interpreting evidence across thousands of studies is impractical to perform manually. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly in large language models (LLMs), provide new opportunities to automate toxicological literature analysis. Results: Herein, we present the Adverse Outcome Pathway Toolkit (AOPTK), an open-source Python package for AI-enhanced analysis of toxicological and biomedical literature. AOPTK supports (i) automated literature retrieval from databases such as PubMed Central and Europe PMC, (ii) direct processing of full-text articles in PDF format, and (iii) LLM-assisted analysis tools to identify chemicals and extract their relationships to biological effects under user-defined conditions. We demonstrate its utilities through a case-study identifying potential non-genotoxic carcinogens based on their ability to inhibit gap junction intercellular communication (GJIC). The LLM-enhanced analysis achieves 81% agreement with an expert-curated inhibitor list and 95% accuracy in predicting inhibition versus no inhibition when analysing the same subset of 86 publications. Automated retrieval and analysis of 1 124 publications from PubMed Central further demonstrated the feasibility of applying AOPTK to large-scale literature analyses. Availability: The package is developed open source on GitHub, disseminated through PyPI and Bioconda and releases are archived on Zenodo. Individual tools are available in the Galaxy platform for accessible data analysis with user-friendly, findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable (FAIR) and end-to-end workflows provided via WorkflowHub. The tools are available on usegalaxy.eu and usegalaxy.cz and are developed open source on GitHub.

title: Leave-One-Out-Cross-Validation Based Machine Learning Algorithms for Efficient, Scalable, and Robust Prediction of Artemisinin Resistance in Plasmodium falciparum Kelch13 mutants.

abstract: Emerging Plasmodium falciparum resistance to frontline artemisinin (ART) derivatives threatens global malaria control efforts. Current protocols assigning ART-sensitive (ART-S) or -resistant (ART-R) phenotypes to parasite strains with Kelch13 (K13) mutations remain time-intensive for real-time surveillance. Ring-survival assay (RSA), an ex vivo gold standard mandates laboratory-adaptation under culture conditions and frequently does not replicate clinical ART-responsiveness, thereby limiting its utility for rapidly triaging newly emerging K13 variants. In contrast, advent of artificial intelligence (AI)-derived models hold potential to screen >100 K13 variants within hours, enabling rapid near-real-time prediction of ART-S/R. Here, we engineered a panel of forty representative K13 variants by computing their relative deviations from wild-type K13 across ten physicochemical and structural descriptors, yielding a compact feature set which captures mutation-induced perturbations in folding, stability, and solvent exposure. These can be further utilized to train and validate AI classifier to predict resistance.

abstract: Gait analytics is utilized for a wide range of health-related applications, ranging from fitness tracking to medical diagnostics, and beyond. Inertial measurement units that are ubiquitously available in mobile devices provide an accessible means of gait analysis but differences in sensor specifications, placement, and recording protocols limit comparability across studies. This study developed and evaluated an analysis-centered data warehouse and standardized quality-assessed processing pipeline to facilitate the integration and joint analysis of heterogeneous gait accelerometer data. Six publicly available datasets including a total of 935 persons were integrated into a star-schema data warehouse, and feature comparability was assessed across datasets and sensor locations. Gender classification served as a proof-of-concept downstream analysis. Gait-cycle extraction, which serves as foundation for feature extraction, was successfully achieved with an accuracy above 99% for the dataset that provides ground truth information. Comparability varied across datasets and sensor configurations, with correlation coefficients between average gait cycles ranging from 0.5 to close to 1.0. Centrally positioned sensors generally show greater correspondence than peripheral sensors, although differences in statistical features persist even between sensors at nominally identical locations. Gender classification performance remains largely near chance level, and no consistent benefit from pooling datasets could be established. These findings demonstrate that heterogeneous gait accelerometer data can be integrated and processed within a common analytical framework, but standardized processing alone does not ensure comparability of the resulting features. The proposed open-source framework implemented in Python provides a foundation for reproducible cross-study gait analysis and for investigating residual heterogeneity associated with datasets and sensor configurations.

abstract: Objective: To identify community - prioritized metadata for reporting and sharing computable phenotypes (CPs), develop a cross-library candidate framework, assess alignment between user requirements and library metadata, and test the feasibility of metadata exchange. Materials and Methods: We combined an international, library - led effort by the Open PhEnomics Network (OPEN) consortium with a UK community consensus-building exercise aimed at improving the FAIRness (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) of CPs. The consortium performed a cross-library field comparison and literature review to inform candidate fields, refined through consortium consensus. The community approach was developed through stakeholder interviews, a survey, and workshop, guided by a working group. Community requirements were interpretively mapped to the resulting framework and classified into conformance tiers. Interoperability was tested by manually and programmatically mapping diabetes-related phenotypes across libraries. Results: The library - led process produced 23 candidate fields spanning phenotype description, data/technical details, and performance domains. Thirteen fields aligned across all five libraries, and 22 fields aligned with published CP library desiderata. Interoperability testing successfully catalogued phenotypes through manual mapping, with API - mediated mapping achieving 63 - 76% metadata field completeness across libraries. A community survey (n=124 respondents) identified six metadata elements with majority support as mandatory: description, coding terminology, phenotype type, version history, unique identifier, and data source. Logic representation and validation requirements were rated as mostly context-dependent. Community - identified priorities showed strong alignment with the OPEN framework, though some requirements were only partially represented. Discussion: Through a consensus - based, community - driven approach, we established a CP framework enabling interoperability across libraries. Conclusion: OPEN provides a credible, community - informed foundation for a FAIR CP metadata standard.

abstract: PURPOSE To develop an automated magnetic resonance imaging based segmentation pipeline for the cranio-cervical venous system (CCVS), a complex anatomical network for which no dedicated segmentation tool is currently available. MATERIALS AND METHODS A retrospective single-center cohort of 194 contrast-enhanced cranio-cervical MRI examinations acquired between 2019 and 2024 was used. Manual reference segmentations were performed on 50 examinations using 3D Slicer. A nnU-Net v2-based segmentation model was trained through an iterative process combining automatic segmentation, manual correction, and retraining. Segmentation performance was assessed using the Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC). The complete processing pipeline was integrated into an open-source software application, VenousNetworkAnalyzer (VNA). RESULTS The final model achieved a mean DSC of 0.94 (95% CI, 0.93-0.95) in five-fold cross-validation on 106 examinations with manual reference segmentations. Iterative optimization progressively reduced manual processing time from approximately 10 hours of fully manual segmentation to less than 10 minutes of manual correction per patient. Application of the final model to the entire cohort enabled the generation of patient-specific three-dimensional reconstructions of the cranio-cervical venous system. The segmentation workflow was successfully integrated into the VNA software environment, allowing automated processing and visualization of MRI datasets. CONCLUSION This study demonstrates the feasibility of automated segmentation of the cranio-cervical venous system from contrast-enhanced MRI using a dedicated deep-learning pipeline. The resulting reduction in processing time and integration into an open-source software platform provide a foundation for future large-scale anatomical studies of cranio-cervical venous draina

abstract: [Gland surgery] Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) frequently exhibits lymph node (LN) metastasis, making early identification of high-risk patients crucial for optimizing treatment strategies. However, robust predictive models and external validation remain limited. This study aimed to develop and validate an artificial intelligence (AI) model for preoperative detection of LN status in PDAC patients. We retrospectively enrolled 233 pathologically confirmed PDAC patients from two high-volume pancreatic surgery centers between July 2015 and July 2022. All patients underwent contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) scans and met strict inclusion and exclusion criteria. Two experienced radiologists independently reviewed imaging. Radiomics analysis was performed using MATLAB and Python-based PyRadiomics. Following feature selection, 14 radiomic features were retained to construct a radiomics score. Three predictive models were developed and compared. From 1,652 extracted radiomic features, 14 were selected to build a radiomics score significantly associated with LN metastasis (P<0.001). Multivariate logistic regression identified tumor location, vascular invasion, white blood cell (WBC) count, platelet count, and radiomics score as independent predictors of LN metastasis, and a nomogram was generated. Various machine learning algorithms were evaluated to identify the optimal model combining radiomic and clinical data. Decision curve analysis demonstrated that the extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) model achieved superior accuracy and stability, with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.86 in the training set and 0.81 in the validation set. We successfully developed a LN metastasis prediction model integrating preoperative CT radiomics and clinical variables. The XGBoost-based model exhibited excellent accuracy, robustness, and generalizability. Future studies should focus on constructing more reliable models through standardized pathological sampling and prospective multicenter trials, alongside advancing imaging techniques to improve identification of small LNs.
zh_abstract: 【背景】[腺体外科] 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）常发生淋巴结（LN）转移，因此尽早识别高风险患者对优化治疗策略至关重要。然而，稳健的预测模型和外部验证仍然有限。本研究旨在建立并验证一种用于术前检测PDAC患者LN状态的人工智能（AI）模型。【方法】我们回顾性纳入了2015年7月至2022年7月期间来自两家高容量胰腺外科中心的233例经病理证实的PDAC患者。所有患者均接受了增强计算机断层扫描（CT），并符合严格的纳入和排除标准。两名经验丰富的放射科医师独立阅片。使用MATLAB和基于Python的PyRadiomics进行影像组学分析。经特征选择后，保留14个影像组学特征以构建影像组学评分。建立并比较了三种预测模型。【结果】从提取的1,652个影像组学特征中，选出14个构建了与LN转移显著相关的影像组学评分（P<0.001）。多因素logistic回归确定肿瘤位置、血管侵犯、白细胞（WBC）计数、血小板计数和影像组学评分为LN转移的独立预测因素，并据此绘制了列线图。评估了多种机器学习算法，以确定结合影像组学和临床数据的最优模型。决策曲线分析显示，极端梯度提升（XGBoost）模型具有更优的准确性和稳定性，训练集的曲线下面积（AUC）为0.86，验证集为0.81。【结论】我们成功建立了一个整合术前CT影像组学和临床变量的LN转移预测模型。基于XGBoost的模型表现出优异的准确性、稳健性和可推广性。未来研究应着眼于通过标准化病理取样和前瞻性多中心试验构建更可靠的模型，同时推进影像技术以改善对小淋巴结的识别。

abstract: Purpose: Surgical operative reports support procedural documentation, surgical training, performance assessment, and workflow review. However, extracting meaningful information often requires extensive manual review and clinical expertise. Automated surgical scene descriptions could reduce this burden by leveraging recurring surgical activities and prior knowledge. Methods: We propose GRAC (Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Captioning), a framework that represents surgical scenes as graphs capturing relationships among instruments, actions, and anatomical structures. Given an input scene graph, GRAC learns to retrieve relevant graph-caption pairs from training data. It compares instrument-tissue interactions between retrieved examples and the input scene, using comparison features to condition retrieved-caption representations during generation. Results: On the EndoVis-18 benchmark, GRAC achieved a CIDEr-D of 5.88, compared with 4.23 for SGT and 3.36 for the strongest conventional Transformer baseline. Exact instrument-action-target triplet-set accuracy reached 52.6%, compared with 32.7% for SGT and 26.2% for the strongest conventional baseline. These results demonstrate improvements in language quality and factual agreement. On TORS, GRAC achieved a CIDEr-D of 5.06, compared with 3.80 for the strongest baseline. Conclusion: GRAC demonstrates that combining structured surgical scene representations with retrieved examples improves surgical scene captioning and produces more contextually meaningful descriptions.

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can structure clinical datasets, but extraction error must be distinguished from discordance in the underlying data. From a real-world cohort of 1{,}045 patients undergoing coronary CT angiography (CCTA), we evaluated whether LLM uncertainty during vessel-level coronary artery disease (CAD) stenosis extraction could identify extraction failure and clinical discordance. References were expert CCTA annotations (253 patients) and subsequent invasive coronary angiography (ICA; 729 patients). We quantify extraction failure as disagreement between stenosis severity in LLM extracted versus expert annotations, and clinical discordance as disagreement in stenosis severity between CCTA and subsequent ICA. Stenosis Margin, selected from ten candidate measures, was used to quantify LLM uncertainty, and generalized estimating equation logistic regression and AUC evaluated its association and incremental discrimination for each failure mode. LLM uncertainty was strongly associated with extraction failure (adjusted OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57--6.69], $P<0.001$) and substantially improved discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity alone (AUC 0.81 to 0.86; $Δ$AUC $+0.06$ [$+0.03$, $+0.09$], $P=0.001$). In contrast, LLM uncertainty weakly associated with clinical discordance (adjusted OR 1.22 [1.04--1.43], Holm-adjusted $P=0.118$) but provided no incremental discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity ($Δ$AUC $+0.01$ [$-0.00$, $+0.02$], $P=0.245$). Moreover, extraction errors and clinical discordance showed little overlap, with 38 of 42 clinically discordant vessels (90%) having been extracted correctly. LLM uncertainty may identify extraction failures without identifying underlying clinical discordance, supporting failure attribution when evaluating LLM-derived clinical datasets.

abstract: Stroke is a disorder of the circulation, yet the haemodynamic state that immediately precedes it has rarely been observed, because continuous physiological recordings before a stroke are seldom available. Photoplethysmography (PPG), recorded by every pulse oximeter and by hundreds of millions of wearable devices, captures the peripheral pulse beat by beat, but its morphology is largely discarded. Here we ask whether pulse waveform morphology encodes haemodynamic signatures of impending stroke. Using in-hospital stroke as a natural experiment that provides continuous PPG before physician-adjudicated stroke recognition, we studied intensive-care (MIMIC-III, $n=176$) and emergency-department (MC-MED, $n=154$) cohorts and described each beat with interpretable descriptors of pulse timing, amplitude, contour and variability. At a nominal 360-min horizon, morphology separated pre-recognition from stable windows with $F_1$ scores of 0.941 and 0.989 (sensitivity 0.998 and 0.980), with models transferred unchanged to the second cohort, and outperformed heart rate alone on identical windows. The signature was dominated by systolic crest time and its change from each patient's own baseline, feature attribution was concordant across cohorts (Spearman $ρ=0.865$), and morphology recorded in the first two hours of care stratified the subsequent clinical course ($F_1$ 0.714 and 0.691). In high-risk patients without stroke, 29% and 14% of windows were positive, but five-window persistence rules limited alerts to 17% and 2% of patients. The results demonstrate that the routinely recorded pulse thus carries haemodynamic imprint of the period preceding stroke, positioning pulse morphology as a candidate continuous cerebrovascular biomarker.
zh_abstract: 卒中是一种循环系统疾病，然而紧邻卒中之前的血流动力学状态却鲜有观察，因为卒中前的连续生理记录很少可得。光电容积脉搏波（PPG）由每台脉搏血氧仪和数亿台可穿戴设备记录，可逐搏捕捉外周脉搏，但其形态在很大程度上被舍弃。在此，我们探讨脉搏波形态是否编码了即将发生卒中的血流动力学特征。我们将院内卒中作为自然实验，其可提供在医生判定卒中识别之前的连续 PPG，研究了重症监护（MIMIC-III，$n=176$）和急诊科（MC-MED，$n=154$）队列，并用可解释的脉搏时相、幅度、轮廓和变异性描述符刻画每一次搏动。在名义上 360 分钟的时间窗下，形态学特征区分识别前窗口与稳定窗口的 $F_1$ 分数分别为 0.941 和 0.989（敏感性 0.998 和 0.980），模型原样迁移至第二个队列，并且在相同窗口上优于仅用心率的模型。该特征以收缩期波峰时间及其相对于每位患者自身基线的变化为主，特征归因在两个队列间一致（Spearman $ρ=0.865$），且在治疗最初两小时内记录的形态可对后续临床病程进行分层（$F_1$ 为 0.714 和 0.691）。在未发生卒中的高危患者中，29% 和 14% 的窗口为阳性，但五窗口持续性规则将警报限制在 17% 和 2% 的患者。结果表明，常规记录的脉搏携带了卒中前阶段的血流动力学印记，使脉搏波形态成为一种有潜力的连续脑血管生物标志物。

abstract: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation remains challenging because subtle pathology can be obscured by overlapping anatomy, image-quality variation, and limited visual evidence in isolated radiographs. Although image-only deep learning models provide useful baselines, they discard the complementary diagnostic context available in radiology reports, while large vision-language models can be computationally expensive for practical deployment. This paper presents CXR-CMFA, a lightweight cross-modal feature aggregation network for binary CXR pathology classification. The proposed framework combines a dual-stream visual encoder, using EfficientNet-B0 for global anatomical representation and DenseNet-121 for local pathological detail, with a TF-IDF-MLP report encoder. Two fusion modules integrate these modalities: the Dual-Modal Spatial Attention Module (DMSAM) uses the report embedding to gate global and local visual features, and the Cross-Modal Gated Feature Fusion (CGFF) module learns per-instance weights for visual and textual contributions. Experiments on the MIMIC-CXR benchmark, using the provided train, validation, and test splits, show that CXR-CMFA achieves 93.45% accuracy, 99.88% precision, 91.8% recall, 95.7% F1-score, and 99.19% AUC on the held-out test set. The model produces only four false positives among 984 normal test cases, supporting its suitability for high-specificity screening workflows. An ablation study further demonstrates a 22.47 percentage-point AUC improvement over the global-image-only variant, confirming the value of adaptive cross-modal fusion. These results indicate that compact report-conditioned fusion can provide strong discriminative performance without relying on large pretrained language models.

abstract: In clinical applications, patients undergo different combinations of tests, and machine learning models must therefore ensure accurate predictions across heterogeneous feature spaces. Current approaches upweight the patients with the highest loss, without accounting for the limited predictive information in their features preventing their loss from going any lower. Moreover, when patients' feature spaces are fully disjoint, current methods reduce to training independent models, preventing knowledge transfer across them. We propose a framework for group robust learning across heterogeneous feature spaces, where groups are patients sharing a feature space. Since a high loss may simply reflect uninformative features, we instead optimize for worst-group excess loss, the gap between a group's loss and an estimate of its achievable optimum. To allow collaboration between groups, we use group-specific encoders mapping into a shared latent space in which learnable Gaussian anchors cluster patients by outcome. On tabular and imaging medical datasets, including fully disjoint feature settings, our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods when groups differ in their optimal losses or cannot train a good model on their own, reducing worst-group loss by up to 79% and excess loss by up to 95% with up to 18$\times$ fewer parameters.

abstract: Multimodal fusion requires not only exchanging information across modalities but also determining which representations should participate in the interaction and how complementary cross-modal views should be combined. We introduce Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating, a fusion framework that integrates token-wise guidance, bidirectional cross-attention, and sample-specific fusion. The proposed method constructs two directional representations: an image-conditioned text representation, obtained by allowing textual tokens to query visual features, and a text-conditioned image representation formed in the reverse direction. Token-wise guidance modulates the representations before cross-attention, while an adaptive gate learns the relative contribution of the two resulting directional representations for each sample. We evaluate the approach using paired chest radiographs and radiology reports as an image-text test bed for binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification. The two cross-attention directions exhibit distinct performance characteristics, demonstrating that reversing the query and source modalities does not produce interchangeable representations. Ablation experiments further show that bidirectional interaction, adaptive gating, and token guidance provide complementary benefits. The proposed model achieves 96.05% accuracy, 96.10% F1-score, 98.37% AUC, 95.60% Sens@95Spec, and 96.51% Spec@95Sens, yielding the highest mean performance across all evaluated metrics. These findings support explicitly modeling interaction direction, token relevance, and sample-dependent integration when constructing multimodal representations.

abstract: Accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) forms images from incomplete Fourier measurements, shifting acquisition burden to computational reconstruction. Deep unrolled networks interleave learned regularization and data consistency, yet typically estimate the full unmeasured spectrum at every cascade. We propose STAIRS (Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling), which projects intermediate reconstructions onto nested Fourier supports that expand to the full spectrum and conditions each update on its support transition. Conditional increments of a regularized log-determinant score of training covariance define a normalized spectral coordinate, accounting for dependencies between newly and previously admitted frequencies. Dyadic targets allocate larger coordinate increments to earlier cascades and are mapped to fixed supports before training, enabling coarse-to-fine reconstruction with unchanged sampling masks and data consistency. On fastMRI and Stanford2D, STAIRS improves matched Transformer (HUMUSNet) and convolutional (NAFNet) backbones in single- and multi-coil reconstruction, including radiologist-annotated pathology regions. It also outperforms predictor-based progression with lower parameter overhead and inference latency. Stage-wise analysis shows repeated error correction by projection and lower intermediate reconstruction errors than the backbones alone throughout support expansion. Ablations favor dyadic allocation over uniform expansion for square and line-band supports and over manual front-loading for square windows. Support projection alone improves reconstruction, and transition conditioning strengthens the gain. Cross-dataset evaluation shows improvements for both backbones in both directions. Support allocation thus complements regularizer design in unrolled MRI reconstruction.

abstract: Unpaired medical image-to-image translation requires synthesizing target-modality images from source-modality images without aligned supervision. Existing methods learn a direct source-to-target mapping that entangles structure preservation and appearance generation within a single model, often distorting clinically meaningful anatomy in the translated output. We argue that these two objectives should be decoupled entirely: anatomical structure should be captured independently of generation, and the generator should operate only on a frozen structural representation. To this end, we propose a two-stage framework for unpaired medical image translation. In the first stage, we learn a shared structure space by training a structure encoder-decoder on source images, target images, and structural masks jointly, using mask reconstruction to anchor the latent space to modality-agnostic anatomy. For source images without mask annotations, a target-domain memory bank provides soft structural supervision via prototype retrieval. In the second stage, a conditional flow model learns to render target-domain appearance under fixed structural conditions. This ensures the generator inherits target appearance statistics and can focus entirely on structural conditioning rather than learning appearance from scratch. We validate our framework on OCT-to-OCTA synthesis and brain MR-to-CT translation. Our method outperforms all unpaired baselines on both tasks and, despite requiring no paired supervision, also surpasses paired baselines, improving PSNR by up to 11.2% and SSIM by up to 26.4% on OCT-to-OCTA, and achieving consistent gains across whole-image, soft-tissue, and bone regions on MR-to-CT. The project repository is available on GitHub.

abstract: [medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences] Genetic conditions are common in congenital heart disease (CHD) and affect care, but are often missed or diagnosed late. We asked whether routine clinical data can shortlist the most likely genetic conditions. Retrospective single-center cohort of children with CHD and an echocardiogram who had either a confirmed genetic diagnosis or negative cytogenetic testing and CHD gene sequencing. Echocardiogram images and serial medical record data were added as model inputs in the order they become clinically available. Class-balanced logistic regression (LR) and a multimodal deep learning fusion network were fitted to the same inputs at each step. The primary metric was balanced top-3 accuracy (correct diagnosis among the top three, averaged across conditions), with bootstrap intervals. The cohort included 1,720 children (988 with common CHD-associated genetic conditions, 231 rare diagnoses, 501 negative testing). Using only inputs generated at the echocardiogram visit, LR reached a balanced top-3 accuracy 0.758 (chance 0.429). Serial records, radiology notes and ICD-10 codes, raised this to 0.809. Multimodal fusion performed similarly at each stage. With a genetic condition withheld from training, the fusion embedding placed affected children nearest to others sharing a gene group in 0.37 of cases versus 0.10 without the embedding (+0.268 [95% CI +0.242, +0.295]). Routine clinical data available at first echocardiogram can help identify likely genetic diagnoses, and later coded inputs ceiling. Multimodal fusion added no accuracy over LR, but places children sharing a genetic cause near one another, making nearest-neighbor retrieval informative for undiagnosed children.

abstract: Machine-learning models based on routine laboratory panels can predict outcomes but can be difficult to interpret and operationalize. We present COMBIO, an automated pipeline that distils such a model into a compact closed-form biomarker. The composite is a product of laboratory measurements raised to integer powers from minus two to two. The sign of each exponent indicates whether higher values of the corresponding measurement increase or decrease the composite. Shapley additive explanation values from the gradient-boosted reference model rank five candidate measurements and guide eligible exponent signs. An exhaustive search over small integer exponents selects the formula on an inner validation set, before evaluation on the reserved test set. We evaluated COMBIO across six tasks: three National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey outcomes, liver-disease classification in the Indian Liver Patient Dataset, and Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV in-hospital mortality and sepsis case-finding, with external evaluation in the eICU Collaborative Research Database for the two hospital tasks. Across the six test sets, COMBIO's area under the receiver operating characteristic curve differed by at most 0.03 from logistic regression using the five candidate laboratory measurements. The hospital mortality composite had an area under the curve of 0.698 in the external database. A version restricted to widely available measurements in the source hospital database achieved an area under the curve of 0.786 in a cohort covering 92% of admissions. The multiplicative representation provides compactness rather than additional accuracy, and local validation and recalibration are required before clinical use.
zh_abstract: 基于常规实验室检查项目的机器学习模型可以预测结局，但往往难以解释和付诸实施。我们提出了COMBIO，这是一种自动化流程，可将此类模型提炼为紧凑的闭式生物标志物。该复合指标是若干实验室测量值的乘积，各测量值的指数为-2至2的整数。每个指数的符号表明相应测量值升高会使复合指标升高还是降低。来自梯度提升参考模型的Shapley加性解释（Shapley additive explanation）值对五个候选测量指标进行排序，并指导可选指数符号。在内部验证集上对小整数指数进行穷举搜索以选出公式，随后在保留的测试集上进行评估。我们在六项任务中评估了COMBIO：三项美国国家健康与营养调查（National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey）结局、印度肝病患者数据集（Indian Liver Patient Dataset）中的肝病分类，以及重症监护医学信息集市IV（Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV）中的院内死亡率和脓毒症病例识别；两项医院任务还在eICU协作研究数据库（eICU Collaborative Research Database）中进行了外部评估。在六个测试集上，COMBIO的受试者操作特征曲线下面积与使用五个候选实验室测量指标的逻辑回归相比，相差至多0.03。院内死亡率复合指标在外部数据库中的曲线下面积为0.698。在源医院数据库中，仅限于广泛可得测量指标的版本，在覆盖92%入院病例的队列中曲线下面积达到0.786。乘积形式的表示提供的是紧凑性，而非额外的准确性；临床使用前需要进行本地验证和重新校准。

abstract: In the healthcare sector, claim denials impose significant financial and administrative burdens, emphasizing the need for automated and trustworthy decision-support systems. This paper proposes a modular Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) framework for healthcare claim denial analysis, integrating specialized agents for denial risk prediction, risk factor identification, diagnosis-procedure-medication code relationship analysis, and counterfactual analysis. The framework integrates predictive analytics, graph-based learning, a Hybrid Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline grounded in healthcare policy documents, and a dedicated HIPAA Compliance Agent to support privacy protection. These findings pave the way for further research into Agentic AI as a framework for explainable, policy-aware, and privacy-preserving healthcare claim denial management.

abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in high-risks decision-making systems across domains such as healthcare, finance, and the judicial system. As reliance on predictive models grows, so does the demand for Explainable AI (XAI) to ensure transparency, trust, and interpretability. However, existing XAI approaches often fail to present explanations in a format accessible to domain experts, limiting their practical utility. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently emerged as a bridge between complex models and end-users, offering natural language explanations. Yet, their use introduces new risks, including hallucinated outputs and lack of source traceability. To address these challenges, we propose a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) that not only combines standard predictive models with XAI techniques but also incorporates a Retrieval-Augmented Generation module as an interactive enhancer. This module grounds explanations in verified medical knowledge, reformulates technical outputs into a human-like format, and enables users-such as clinicians-to actively query the system. By fostering an interactive, human-in-the-loop environment, our approach empowers domain experts to explore model decisions, contextualize explanations, and build trust in AI-assisted diagnostics. The study concludes with preliminary experiments validating the proposed methodology.

abstract: While feed-forward segmentation networks perform well on large cohorts, they degrade in constrained clinical settings with few training samples and imaging artifacts. Human vision, by contrast, remains robust under these conditions, a property partly attributed to the recurrent and feedback connectivity of the visual cortex, which refines visual information over time. Inspired by this, we append lightweight recurrent refinement blocks to segmentation backbones, namely Conditional Random Fields (CRFs), modern Hopfield networks and convolutional GRUs, and study their behaviour as the number of iterations increases at test time (including beyond the training horizon). Evaluated on two open-source datasets, Kvasir- SEG and ARCADE, our recurrent blocks add less than 1.5% parameters and yield gains on clean data (up to 1.4 pp) and under noise (up to 17 pp) while reducing HD95. Code is available at https://github.com/joaodsmarques/recurrencehelpsegmentation .
zh_abstract: 尽管前馈分割网络在大型队列上表现良好，但在训练样本少且存在成像伪影的受限临床场景中，其性能会下降。相比之下，人类视觉在这些条件下依然稳健，这一特性部分归因于视觉皮层的循环和反馈连接，它们可随时间对视觉信息进行精炼。受此启发，我们在分割骨干网络后附加轻量级循环精炼模块，即条件随机场（Conditional Random Fields, CRFs）、现代Hopfield网络（modern Hopfield networks）和卷积GRU（convolutional GRUs），并研究其在测试时随迭代次数增加（包括超出训练迭代范围）的行为。在Kvasir-SEG和ARCADE两个开源数据集上的评估显示，我们的循环模块增加的参数不足1.5%，在干净数据上带来提升（最高1.4个百分点），在噪声条件下带来提升（最高17个百分点），同时降低了HD95。代码见 https://github.com/joaodsmarques/recurrencehelpsegmentation 。

abstract: Background: Binary hypotension forecasts do not describe the depth and duration of future low pressure. Burden forecasts may support graded early warning, but better forecast scores need not yield more useful alerts. Objective: To evaluate conditional quantiles of the next 15-minute mean arterial pressure (MAP) deficit below 65 mmHg and distinguish forecasting performance from episode-warning performance. Methods: Public VitalDB numeric arterial MAP was reduced to 10-second medians without forward filling. Subject-disjoint training, validation and test splits included 70,402, 14,270 and 15,575 labeled windows. We compared climatology, calibrated persistence, last-MAP-only boosting, and direct and residual quantile boosting, with and without additional MAP-history features. Patient-weighted pinball loss and subject-bootstrap intervals evaluated forecasting. Validation selected alert thresholds before a hash-recorded test evaluation. Results: In the test split, the prespecified residual-versus-persistence comparison at the 90th percentile yielded losses of 2.256 and 2.900 mmHg-min, respectively (difference -0.644; 95% interval -0.814 to -0.487). Direct prediction achieved 2.196, and direct prediction with additional MAP features achieved 2.193. Episode-warning results were sensitive to the alert rule and operating threshold. Conclusions: This retrospective benchmark separates burden-forecast skill from warning-policy performance. Findings support further study of direct burden estimation; they do not establish patient benefit, prospective reliability or transportability beyond the source hospital.
zh_abstract: 【背景】二元低血压预测无法描述未来低血压的深度和持续时间。负荷（burden）预测可能有助于分级早期预警，但预测评分更好并不一定带来更有用的警报。【目的】评估未来15分钟内平均动脉压（MAP）低于65 mmHg的不足量的条件分位数，并区分预测性能与发作预警性能。【方法】将公开的VitalDB有创动脉MAP数值数据处理为10秒中位数，不做前向填充。按受试者互不重叠划分的训练集、验证集和测试集分别包含70,402、14,270和15,575个已标注窗口。我们比较了气候学基线（climatology）、校准持续性预测（calibrated persistence）、仅使用最近一次MAP的提升（boosting）模型，以及直接分位数提升和残差分位数提升模型，每种均分别在有和没有额外MAP历史特征的情况下进行。预测评估采用按患者加权的pinball损失和按受试者自助法（bootstrap）得到的区间。在记录哈希值的测试评估之前，由验证集选定警报阈值。【结果】在测试集中，预先设定的第90百分位数残差模型与持续性预测的比较显示，损失分别为2.256和2.900 mmHg·min（差值-0.644；95%区间-0.814至-0.487）。直接预测的损失为2.196，加入额外MAP特征的直接预测为2.193。发作预警结果对警报规则和操作阈值较为敏感。【结论】这一回顾性基准研究将负荷预测技能与预警策略性能区分开来。研究结果支持进一步研究直接负荷估计；但并不能证明对患者有益，也不能证明前瞻性可靠性，或在来源医院之外的可迁移性。

abstract: Machine learning based segmentation models are frequently miscalibrated, producing for each pixel a label prediction whose associated confidence does not accurately reflect the true underlying probability. This limitation is particularly critical in high-stakes applications such as medical image segmentation. Although several calibration methods have been proposed, only a small subset of them provides theoretical guarantees on the calibration error, i.e., they do not typically ensure that, with high probability, the model exhibits a low calibration error. In this work, we develop a post-hoc calibration method for which formal calibration guarantees can be established. To achieve this, we derive from standard concentration inequalities an improved theoretical bound that explicitly accounts for the spatial dependence inherent in binary segmentation outputs. We empirically demonstrate that the proposed calibrator satisfies the derived guarantee and outperforms existing post-hoc calibration approaches.
zh_abstract: 基于机器学习的分割模型经常存在校准不良的问题，即为每个像素给出的标签预测，其相应置信度并不能准确反映真实的潜在概率。这一局限在医学图像分割等高风险应用中尤为关键。尽管已有多种校准方法被提出，但其中只有一小部分能对校准误差提供理论保证，即它们通常无法确保模型以高概率表现出较低的校准误差。在本工作中，我们提出了一种可建立形式化校准保证的事后（post-hoc）校准方法。为此，我们从标准集中不等式出发，推导出一个改进的理论界，明确考虑了二值分割输出中固有的空间依赖性。我们通过实验证明，所提出的校准器满足所推导的保证，并且优于现有的事后校准方法。

abstract: [Pediatric annals] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming health care and has important implications for pediatric hospital medicine. Advances in machine learning and large language models have enabled applications that support patient care in the areas of clinical documentation, decision making, and prognostic modeling. Pediatric AI systems leverage diverse data sources, including electronic health records, medical imaging, physiologic monitoring, wearable devices, and genomic data. title: NanoNet: Ultra-Lightweight Network for MRI Brain Tumor Classification toward Edge AI

summary: 提出仅8,132参数的超轻量CNN，在BRISC 2025基准上达92.80%准确率，并探索剪枝、蒸馏与INT8量化。

abstract: Automated brain tumor classification from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can support accessible medical image analysis, but conventional deep learning models often exceed the resource budgets of highly constrained edge-AI platforms. We present NanoNet, an ultra-lightweight convolutional neural network designed for resourceconstrained MRI classification and motivated by future edge-AI applications. Inspired by MobileNetV2, NanoNet substantially reduces network depth, channel capacity, expansion ratios, and final feature dimensionality, resulting in only five inverted residual blocks and 8,132 parameters. We further investigate dependency-aware structured pruning, knowledge distillation, and INT8 quantization-aware training for additional compression. Experiments on the BRISC 2025 benchmark show that NanoNet achieves 92.80% accuracy and 92.97% macro F1 with 8,132 parameters and 10.498 MFLOPs. Across three compression seeds, it exceeds the mean accuracy of 70%-pruned MobileNetV2 by 5.20 percentage points while using 60.2% fewer parameters and 9.8% less computation. Converted INT8 NanoNet achieves 89.70% accuracy and 90.22% macro F1 across three QAT seeds. Earlier TensorFlow Lite measurements indicate 27.7 KB of baseline model storage, motivating future edge-AI deployment.
zh_abstract: 基于磁共振成像（MRI）的脑肿瘤自动分类可支持便捷的医学图像分析，但传统深度学习模型往往超出高度受限的边缘人工智能（edge-AI）平台的资源预算。我们提出了 NanoNet，这是一种超轻量级卷积神经网络，专为资源受限的 MRI 分类而设计，并面向未来的边缘人工智能应用。NanoNet 受 MobileNetV2 启发，大幅减少了网络深度、通道容量、扩展比和最终特征维度，仅含五个倒残差块和 8,132 个参数。我们进一步研究了依赖感知的结构化剪枝、知识蒸馏和 INT8 量化感知训练，以实现额外压缩。在 BRISC 2025 基准上的实验表明，NanoNet 以 8,132 个参数和 10.498 MFLOPs 取得了 92.80% 的准确率和 92.97% 的宏平均 F1。在三个压缩随机种子下，其平均准确率比剪枝 70% 的 MobileNetV2 高 5.20 个百分点，同时参数减少 60.2%，计算量减少 9.8%。转换后的 INT8 NanoNet 在三个 QAT 种子下取得了 89.70% 的准确率和 90.22% 的宏平均 F1。早期的 TensorFlow Lite 测量显示基线模型存储为 27.7 KB，这为未来的边缘人工智能部署提供了依据。

abstract: [Research square] Introduction Sepsis-induced organ dysfunction remains a leading cause of mortality in critical care. While recent evidence suggests that Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE) may improve outcomes, significant heterogeneity among septic patient populations in prior trials might have contributed to mixed responses and thus fueled clinical skepticism. To address this challenge and to model TPE effectiveness across varying levels of sepsis severity, we utilized a time-dependent, 8-state transition Markov model integrated with a Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) framework. Methods An AI-generated "digital twin" cohort (N = 10,000) was randomized 1:1 to standard care (SC) or adjuvant TPE groups. Transition probabilities were parameterized using a pooled relative risk (RR) of 0.58, derived from five recent meta-analyses. The model incorporated specific hazard multipliers for acute kidney injury (AKI; 1.5x), thrombocytopenia (1.3x), and high-dose vasopressor requirements (1.25x). Patient flow was simulated through eight clinically defined health states over a 28-day horizon. Outcomes included 28-day survival, absolute risk reduction (ARR), and number needed to treat (NNT) stratified by Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score quartiles (8, 12, 16, and 20). Bayesian methods were employed to determine survival probabilities and hazard ratios (HR) with 95% credible intervals (CrI). Results Across the modelled full 10,000-patient cohort, TPE increased 28 day survival compared to standard care (67.3% vs. 44.7%). The survival benefit was modest in the group with the lowest degree of organ failure (SOFA 8) (TPE 87.6% vs. SC 78.4%; ARR 9.2%; NNT 11). However, this benefit was more pronounced in cases of higher burden of organ failure, particularly within the SOFA 20 cohort (TPE 48.8% vs. SC 12.8%; ARR 36%; NNT 3) and in cases with AKI + thrombocytopenia + higher doses of vasopressors (ARR 36%; NNT 3). For SOFA 20 patients, TPE was associated with a 38% reduction in the hazard of death (HR 0.62; 95% CrI 0.54-0.71). Conclusion These simulation results suggests that the efficacy of TPE might be dependent on baseline illness severity. While the clinical impact is more limited in moderate sepsis (SOFA 8), TPE appears to offer a profound survival advantage and high therapeutic yield for patients with multi-organ failure.
zh_abstract: [Research square]【引言】脓毒症所致器官功能障碍仍是重症监护中死亡的主要原因。尽管近期证据提示治疗性血浆置换（TPE）可能改善预后，但既往试验中脓毒症患者群体存在显著异质性，这可能导致结果不一，进而加剧了临床上的怀疑。为应对这一挑战，并在不同脓毒症严重程度下模拟 TPE 的有效性，我们采用了结合贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）框架的时间依赖性 8 状态转移马尔可夫模型。【方法】将一个由人工智能生成的“数字孪生”队列（N = 10,000）按 1:1 随机分配至标准治疗（SC）组或辅助 TPE 组。转移概率以汇总相对风险（RR）0.58 进行参数化，该值来自五项近期荟萃分析。模型纳入了针对急性肾损伤（AKI；1.5 倍）、血小板减少（1.3 倍）和大剂量血管活性药物需求（1.25 倍）的特定风险乘数。模拟患者在 28 天时间范围内经历八个临床定义的健康状态。结局包括 28 天生存率、绝对风险降低（ARR）以及按序贯器官衰竭评估（SOFA）评分分层（8、12、16 和 20）的需治疗人数（NNT）。采用贝叶斯方法确定生存概率和风险比（HR）及其 95% 可信区间（CrI）。【结果】在模拟的全部 10,000 例患者队列中，与标准治疗相比，TPE 提高了 28 天生存率（67.3% 对 44.7%）。在器官衰竭程度最低的组（SOFA 8）中，生存获益较小（TPE 87.6% 对 SC 78.4%；ARR 9.2%；NNT 11）。然而，在器官衰竭负担较重的情况下获益更为明显，尤其是在 SOFA 20 队列（TPE 48.8% 对 SC 12.8%；ARR 36%；NNT 3），以及合并 AKI、血小板减少和较大剂量血管活性药物的情况中（ARR 36%；NNT 3）。对于 SOFA 20 的患者，TPE 与死亡风险降低 38% 相关（HR 0.62；95% CrI 0.54-0.71）。【结论】这些模拟结果提示，TPE 的疗效可能取决于基线疾病严重程度。在中度脓毒症（SOFA 8）中，临床影响较为有限，而对于多器官衰竭患者，TPE 似乎能带来显著的生存优势和较高的治疗收益。

abstract: Skeleton-based rehabilitation assessment faces fundamental limitations of fixed topologies which cannot model compensatory patterns, uniform joint treatments overlook clinically important deviations, and lack of geometric understand- ing. We propose Concave-Convex Decomposition Sparse Topological Graph Convolutional Network (CC2-STG), a multi-stream model that combines geo- metric decomposition, sparse feature learning, and adaptive topology. Our framework decomposes joint relationships into complementary convex-concave distance functions to model both local and global movement characteristics, with sparse regularization with proximal optimization selecting clinically relevant geo- metric features, while multi-scale topological analysis captures non-anatomical joint dependencies in pathological movements. Experiments on the KiMoRe and UIPRMD datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art performance on clinical pathological movement assessment.
zh_abstract: 基于骨架的康复评估面临以下根本性局限：固定拓扑无法对代偿模式建模，对关节的统一处理忽略了具有临床意义的偏差，且缺乏几何理解。我们提出凹凸分解稀疏拓扑图卷积网络（Concave-Convex Decomposition Sparse Topological Graph Convolutional Network，CC2-STG），这是一种结合几何分解、稀疏特征学习和自适应拓扑的多流模型。我们的框架将关节关系分解为互补的凸-凹距离函数，以同时刻画局部和全局的运动特征；通过带近端优化的稀疏正则化选取与临床相关的几何特征，同时多尺度拓扑分析捕捉病理运动中的非解剖关节依赖关系。在 KiMoRe 和 UIPRMD 数据集上的实验验证了我们方法的有效性，在临床病理运动评估上取得了最先进的性能。
